📄 Complete Details & Notification

The AIIMS Rajkot Faculty Eligibility List 2026 has been released by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rajkot for Faculty Recruitment (Group-A) on Direct Recruitment / Deputation Basis. This recruitment was advertised under F. No. AIIMS/Rajkot/Admin/Recruitment/Faculty/2026-27/3360 dated 11/06/2026. The Scrutiny Committee checked all the applications and then prepared a list that puts each candidate under Eligible, Provisionally Eligible or Ineligible.

Provisionally Eligible candidates must email the documents or clarifications named against them before 05:00 PM on 20/11/2026. The final eligibility status will be published on or before 27/11/2026. Below you will find the overview, important dates, the subjects and posts in the list, the steps to check your status, what to do next and the PDF links.

How to Check AIIMS Rajkot Faculty Eligibility List 2026?

The eligibility list is a PDF on the AIIMS Rajkot website, www.aiimsrajkot.edu.in. Follow these steps to find your eligibility status.

  1. Visit the official website, www.aiimsrajkot.edu.in.
  2. Open the page that lists the Eligibility Notice and the Provisional Eligibility List.
  3. Download the Provisional Eligibility List PDF.
  4. Search the PDF for your Candidate ID or name.
  5. Check your Status and the Remarks column against your name.
  6. Download the Eligibility Notice to read the instructions and the name affidavit format.

Details Mentioned in AIIMS Rajkot Faculty Eligibility List 2026

Each entry in the AIIMS Rajkot list shows the candidate's applied category and status. The Remarks column lists any documents still due or the reason for ineligibility. The list has these columns:

  • Sr. No.
  • Candidate ID
  • Name of the Candidate
  • Subject
  • Post
  • Category as per Certificate
  • Applied Category
  • Status
  • Remarks

AIIMS Rajkot Faculty Eligibility Status Categories 2026

The AIIMS Rajkot Eligibility Notice explains the three statuses below. It says that the reasons for ineligibility are given in the Remarks column.

StatusMeaning as per Notice
EligibleCandidates found eligible as per the prescribed eligibility criteria.
Provisionally EligibleEligibility is subject to submission of the requisite documents/clarifications mentioned against their names in the remarks column.
IneligibleCandidates who do not fulfil the prescribed eligibility criteria.

Some of the documents asked for in the Remarks column are an NOC from the current employer, an OBC-NCL certificate for the current financial year as per "Annexure III:Format for OBC Certificate", 10th / 12th marksheets, and medical council registration certificates. Ineligibility reasons in the list include "Teaching and /or Research experience less than Three years" and "Educational Qualification not according to concerned Speciality".

What After AIIMS Rajkot Faculty Eligibility List 2026?

Candidates must email their documents to [email protected] before 05:00 PM on 20/11/2026. AIIMS Rajkot will then publish the final eligibility status on or before 27/11/2026.

  • Provisionally Eligible candidates must email the documents or clarifications named against them in the Remarks column.
  • A candidate who disagrees with the Scrutiny Committee's decision may email a representation with supporting documents by the same deadline.
  • All candidates, except those who have already sent them, must email a Valid ID proof and a Passport Size Photograph and bring them to the interview.
  • If the name on the application form does not match the documents, the candidate must send a notarized affidavit in the format attached to the notice.
  • Original documents will be verified on the interview day, before the interview. Only candidates whose documents are verified and found eligible may attend.
  • The interview must be attended in person. Online interviews are not permitted.
  • The interview date will be notified on the AIIMS Rajkot website.

RRB Group D Scorecard 2026

As mentioned in the result notice, the CBT scorecard link will be activated on 16 November 2026 on the official RRB website. Candidates will be able to view their CBT marks by logging in with their credentials. Keep your registration details ready before that date.

RRB Group D Cut Off 2026

The RRBs have released the cut off marks along with the result, separately for each zone and category. Cut off is based on normalised CBT marks, because the CBT was held over many days and shifts. Normalisation is applied whenever a CBT is conducted in multiple sessions for the same syllabus.

The cut off differs from zone to zone and category to category. For example, the RRB Bhopal cut off for the Unreserved category is about 79.81 marks. For your own zone and category, check the cut off PDF published by your RRB.

Also Read: RRB Group D Cut Off 2026

Minimum Qualifying Marks in the CBT

Every candidate must first meet the minimum qualifying percentage for their category. Meeting this percentage alone does not guarantee shortlisting, because shortlisting for the PET depends on merit within each RRB and category.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR 40%
EWS 40%
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 30%
SC 30%
ST 30%

For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), these percentages may be relaxed by up to 2 marks if there is a shortage of PwBD candidates against the vacancies reserved for them. The CBT carries negative marking of one-third mark for every wrong answer.

Documents to Keep Ready for PET and Document Verification

The official checklist for the next stage is issued along with the call letter. Until it is released, the following documents, drawn from the CEN 09/2025 notification, are an indicative list. Originals are required at Document Verification.

  • Educational and technical qualification certificates required for the post
  • Matriculation or 10th class certificate showing name and date of birth
  • Valid original photo identity proof
  • SC or ST certificate in the prescribed format, for candidates in these categories
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed format, issued on or after 1 April 2025 and valid on the closing date of application, with the self-declaration
  • Income and Asset Certificate based on financial year 2024-25, for EWS candidates
  • EBC certificate, BPL card or equivalent document, for candidates who claimed the concessional fee
  • Disability certificate with Unique Disability Identity (UDID), for PwBD candidates
  • Ex-Servicemen documents and declaration, for Ex-Servicemen candidates
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate, for Course Completed Act Apprentices
  • No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for candidates already in government service
  • Gazette notification or other legal document, for candidates whose name differs from the 10th class certificate

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Shortlisting in the CBT result is provisional. Eligibility is verified against original documents only at Document Verification, and a wrong claim leads to cancellation of candidature.
  • Qualifying in the PET and later stages does not give a right to appointment. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.
  • Check the result and download call letters only from the official RRB and RRC websites. Beware of fake websites and job racketeers.
  • Dates and venues of PET, Document Verification and Medical Examination will be shared through the official websites, SMS and email. Requests to change a date, shift or venue are not entertained.
  • Keep your registered mobile number and email ID active, because all communication is sent there.

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

How to Download KTET Hall Ticket 2026?

Follow these steps to download the KTET September 2026 Hall Ticket:

Who Is Eligible for This Written Exam?

How to Download BSF Tradesman Admit Card 2026

Once the link is active, follow these steps:

  1. Go to the official BSF recruitment website, rectt.bsf.gov.in.
  2. On the home page, under Important Links, click the admit card link for Constable (Tradesmen) in BSF Exam-2024-25.

  4. Enter your Roll Number and Date of Birth.
  5. Type the Security PIN shown on the page.
  6. Click Login to open and download your admit card.

Details Needed to Log In

  • Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Security PIN shown on the login page

If you do not know your roll number, check the email or message sent to your registered email ID and mobile number.

BSF Tradesman Exam Pattern 2026

The written exam is a Computer Based Test of 100 questions carrying 100 marks. The total duration is 2 hours. The paper has four sections of 25 questions each.

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness / General Knowledge 25 25
Knowledge of Elementary Mathematics 25 25
Analytical Aptitude and Ability to Observe Distinguished Patterns 25 25
Basic Knowledge of English or Hindi 25 25
Total 100 100

Negative Marking

There is negative marking in the objective tests. One-fourth (1/4) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer.

Qualifying Marks

  • UR, EWS and Ex-Servicemen: 35%
  • SC, ST and OBC: 33%

The notice also states that no minimum qualifying marks are prescribed for individual tests or for the aggregate score, and that section-wise marks will not be maintained.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Download the admit card only from the official website, rectt.bsf.gov.in.
  • Enter your roll number and date of birth exactly as in your application.
  • Check the details printed on the admit card carefully after downloading.
  • Keep the printed admit card safe for the exam day.
  • Check your registered email and mobile number for the admit card link sent by BSF.

Exam centre address, reporting time and the list of documents to carry are not mentioned in the official notice. Read the instructions printed on your admit card for these details.

How to Download Union Bank of India SO Admit Card 2026

Union Bank of India has activated the call letter download facility for candidates appearing in the online examination. Follow these steps to download the Union Bank SO Admit Card 2026:

  1. Visit the official Union Bank of India website at unionbankofindia.bank.in.
  2. Open the Recruitment / Careers section.
  3. Find the link related to Union Bank Recruitment Project 2026-27.
  4. Click on the Online Examination Call Letter / Admit Card download link.

Details Mentioned on the Union Bank SO Admit Card

  • Post code
  • Online examination date
  • Reporting time

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

Candidates appearing for the Union Bank SO online examination should carry the required documents mentioned in their call letter.

These generally include:

  • Printout of the Union Bank SO Admit Card 2026
  • One valid original photo identity proof such as:
    • Aadhaar Card
    • PAN Card
    • Passport
    • Driving Licence
  • Passport-size photograph, preferably the same photograph uploaded during the application process, if required in the call letter
  • Photocopy of the photo ID proof, if instructed

Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted as valid photo identity proof.

Candidates should carefully read the instructions printed on their individual call letter because document requirements may vary.

Union Bank SO Recruitment 2026: Post & Vacancy Snapshot

Union Bank Recruitment Project 2026-27 covers a total of 395 vacancies for Specialist Officers, General Banking Officers and Officers with Domain Expertise.

The recruitment includes posts across scales from MMGS-II to TEGS-VI, covering Post Codes S01 to S108.

Vacancies are available across several professional domains, including:

  • Information Technology
  • Risk Management
  • Law
  • Forex
  • Credit
  • Data Science
  • Chartered Accountancy
  • Other specialist and domain-specific areas

Candidates should refer to the official recruitment notification for the complete post-wise and category-wise vacancy distribution.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have announced 1,688 vacancies for 12th-pass candidates under CEN No. 07/2026. The recruitment includes Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Accounts Clerk cum Typist, Junior Clerk cum Typist and Trains Clerk posts. Online applications open on 15 October 2026 and close on 15 November 2026 at 11:59 PM through the unified RRB recruitment website.

This Railway NTPC 2026 Undergraduate recruitment offers initial basic pay of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 21,700, depending on the post. Candidates aged 18 to 30 years as on 1 January 2027, with applicable relaxations, can apply if they meet the Class 12 qualification and medical requirements. Selection includes CBT-1, CBT-2, document verification and medical examination. No separate typing skill test will be conducted under CEN 07/2026. Candidates should check the post-wise vacancies, age limit, application fee, RRB preferences and examination pattern before applying.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Overview

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 is being conducted under Centralised Employment Notice 07/2026 for four Non-Technical Popular Categories posts. The following table covers the vacancy count, qualification, age, salary, application dates, fee, refund, selection process, examination pattern and other important candidate requirements.

Railway Recruitment Boards have announced 1,688 undergraduate vacancies across four posts. Commercial cum Ticket Clerk has the highest number of vacancies at 700, followed by Junior Clerk cum Typist with 600 posts.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The notification normally requires at least 50% aggregate marks, but specified candidates are exempt from this minimum-percentage condition.

RRB NTPC 12th Pass Educational Qualification 2026

Post Name Qualification
Commercial cum Ticket Clerk 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Accounts Clerk cum Typist 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Junior Clerk cum Typist 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Trains Clerk 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions

Qualification Cut-off: The required educational qualification must be completed by 15 November 2026. Candidates awaiting final examination results are not eligible to apply.

Is 50% Required in Class 12 for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Normally, candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 12. However, the minimum 50% condition is not applicable to the following candidates:

  • Scheduled Caste candidates.
  • Scheduled Tribe candidates.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • Ex-Servicemen.
  • Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12.

Can Graduates Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

The age limit for all four RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts is 18 to 30 years as on 1 January 2027. Age relaxation is available to eligible reserved and other notified categories.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Salary 2026

RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts are placed under Pay Levels 2 and 3 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The Commercial cum Ticket Clerk post carries initial basic pay of Rs. 21,700, while the remaining three posts carry Rs. 19,900.

Trains Clerk Level 2 Rs. 19,900

These are initial basic pay figures, not the total monthly take-home salary.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Fee 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT.

Category Application Fee Refund After CBT-1
General / Other Non-exempt Candidates Rs. 500 Rs. 400, less bank charges
SC / ST Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Ex-Servicemen Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
PwBD Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Female Candidates Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Transgender Candidates Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges

Payment Methods: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card and UPI.

RRB NTPC Examination Fee Refund Rules 2026

  • Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund.
  • The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges.
  • Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification.
  • Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar.
  • Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund.

Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist.

  1. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts.
  2. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post.

Is There a Typing Test in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer.

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 40 40
Mathematics 30 30
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30 30
Total 100 100

Duration: 90 Minutes.

Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer.

Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-2 Exam Pattern 2026

Candidates shortlisted through CBT-1 will appear for CBT-2. The second-stage CBT contains 120 questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes.

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 50 50
Mathematics 35 35
General Intelligence and Reasoning 35 35
Total 120 120

Duration: 90 Minutes.

Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer.

Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes.

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage

EWS 40%
OBC-NCL 30%
SC 30%
ST 25%

These minimum qualifying percentages apply to the CBTs. PwBD candidates may receive the specified relaxation when the notification's conditions are met. Qualifying marks alone do not guarantee shortlisting.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Syllabus 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions.

Mathematics Syllabus

  • Number System, Decimals and Fractions
  • LCM and HCF
  • Ratio and Proportion
  • Percentages
  • Mensuration
  • Time and Work
  • Time and Distance
  • Simple and Compound Interest
  • Profit and Loss
  • Elementary Algebra
  • Geometry and Trigonometry
  • Elementary Statistics

General Intelligence and Reasoning Syllabus

  • Analogies
  • Number and Alphabetical Series
  • Coding and Decoding
  • Mathematical Operations
  • Similarities and Differences
  • Relationships and Analytical Reasoning
  • Syllogism
  • Venn Diagrams
  • Puzzles and Data Sufficiency
  • Statement and Conclusion
  • Decision Making
  • Maps and Graph Interpretation

General Awareness Syllabus

  • Current Affairs - National and International
  • Indian History and Freedom Struggle
  • Indian and World Geography
  • Indian Polity and Constitution
  • Indian Economy
  • General Science up to Class 10 Level
  • Sports, Art, Culture and Literature
  • Computer Basics and Applications
  • Science and Technology Developments
  • Government Schemes and Programmes
  • Environmental Issues
  • Indian Transport Systems
  • Important National and International Organizations

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Medical Standards 2026

Each undergraduate post has a prescribed railway medical standard. Candidates must satisfy the required fitness and vision conditions for the post they select.

Post Name Medical Standard
Commercial cum Ticket Clerk B-2
Accounts Clerk cum Typist C-2
Junior Clerk cum Typist C-2
Trains Clerk A-3

Can Candidates with LASIK Surgery Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate 2026?

Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 15 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later.

  1. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/.
  2. Open the recruitment link for CEN No. 07/2026 - NTPC Undergraduate.
  3. Read the detailed notification, Annexure A and RRB-wise vacancy tables in Annexure B.
  4. Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials.
  5. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address.
  6. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal.
  7. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board.
  8. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details.
  9. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully.
  10. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal.
  11. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
  12. Review the information and declaration carefully.
  13. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method.
  14. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details.

Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026

The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection.

Live Photograph Requirements

  • The candidate's photograph must be captured live through the application system.
  • Do not upload or photograph an existing printed photograph.
  • Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching.

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application modification window will remain open from 16 November to 25 November 2026. Candidates can change permitted application details by paying a non-refundable modification fee of Rs. 250 for each modification.

IOCL Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), Marketing Division, Eastern Region, has released Advertisement No. IOCL/MKTG/ER/APPR/2026-27 dated 13 November 2026 for the engagement of 409 Trade, Technician and Graduate Apprentices under the Apprentices Act. The recruitment covers West Bengal, Bihar, Odisha, Jharkhand, Assam, Sikkim, Tripura, Nagaland, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Manipur, Arunachal Pradesh and the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands. Candidates with the prescribed Class 10 with ITI, Class 12, three-year Engineering Diploma or Graduation qualifications can apply according to their discipline. The age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 30 November 2026, with applicable relaxation. Online applications are accepted from 13 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to 12 December 2026 at 5:00 PM through the NAPS and NATS apprenticeship portals.

Candidates applying for the Indian Oil Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must register and apply for the relevant apprenticeship opportunity through NAPS or NATS and then complete the mandatory Microsoft Form for training-location preferences and document verification. Selection will be based on marks obtained in the prescribed qualifying examination, followed by document verification and medical fitness assessment. No written examination or interview will be conducted. The apprenticeship duration is 12 months, and the monthly stipend will be paid according to the applicable Apprentices Act and Rules.

The merit list will be prepared using the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed essential qualification for the selected apprenticeship discipline.

Yes. Shortlisted candidates must complete the pre-engagement medical fitness assessment according to IndianOil's prescribed guidelines.

Engagement is subject to successful document verification and medical fitness.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

The essential educational qualification differs between Junior Engineer and MTS posts. Candidates must meet the requirements of the department for which they seek consideration by 11 December 2026.

DSSSB Junior Engineer Electrical Qualification 2026

Department Essential Qualification Experience
NDMC Degree in Electrical Engineering OR Diploma in Electrical Engineering 2 Years for Diploma Holders; Not Required for Degree Holders
Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Equivalent 2 Years in Electrical Installation / Maintenance
MCD Degree in Electrical Engineering OR Diploma in Electrical Engineering 2 Years for Diploma Holders; Not Required for Degree Holders
Delhi Transco Limited Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering Not Required
Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Equivalent Not Required

Can Fresh Engineering Graduates Apply for DSSSB JE 2026?

Yes. Eligible candidates with an Electrical Engineering degree can apply for the NDMC, MCD and Delhi Transco Limited vacancies without mandatory previous experience, subject to each department's qualification and age conditions.

However, the Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board and DUSIB specify a diploma-based qualification route. Applicants should not assume that every engineering qualification is accepted for every department without checking the applicable Recruitment Rules.

Can Diploma Holders Apply for DSSSB Junior Engineer?

Yes. Electrical Engineering diploma holders can apply, but experience requirements differ by department.

  • NDMC: Two years of professional Electrical Engineering experience required for diploma holders.
  • Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board: Two years of electrical installation or maintenance experience required.
  • MCD: Two years of professional experience as Electrical Engineer after completing the qualifying diploma.
  • Delhi Transco Limited: No essential experience required.
  • DUSIB: No essential experience required.

DSSSB MTS Educational Qualification 2026

Department / Post Essential Qualification Experience
Directorate of Education - MTS General Duty Matriculation / Class 10 or Equivalent Not Required
Directorate of Education - MTS Aaya (Female) Matriculation / Class 10 or Equivalent Not Required
Department of Trade & Taxes Matriculation or Equivalent Not Required
Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board Class 10 Pass OR ITI Pass Not Required
Directorate of Higher Education Matriculation or Equivalent Not Required
Weights and Measures Department Matriculation or Equivalent Not Required
Principal Accounts Office Matriculation or Equivalent Not Required
Land & Building Department Matriculation or Equivalent Not Required
Office of the Chief Electoral Officer Matriculation or Equivalent Not Required

Can 10th Pass Candidates Apply for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Class 10 or Matriculation pass candidates can apply for the notified MTS positions, subject to the age and other eligibility conditions.

For the DUSIB MTS post, the advertisement also permits an ITI qualification from a recognized institute as an alternative route.

Is Work Experience Required for DSSSB MTS Posts?

No previous work experience is prescribed as an essential requirement for the notified MTS vacancies.

Who Can Apply for DSSSB MTS Aaya (Female)?

The Directorate of Education has advertised 239 MTS Aaya (Female) vacancies. Eligible female candidates with a recognized Class 10/Matriculation qualification and the prescribed age can apply.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The ordinary age limit is 18 to 27 years for most vacancies. The NDMC Junior Engineer (Electric) post has an age limit of 18 to 32 years. Age eligibility is determined as on 11 December 2026.

DSSSB JE and MTS Department-Wise Age Limit

Department / Post Age Limit
NDMC - Junior Engineer (Electric) 18-32 Years
Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board - JE Electrical 18-27 Years
MCD - JE Electrical 18-27 Years
Delhi Transco Limited - JE Electrical 18-27 Years
DUSIB - JE Electrical 18-27 Years
MTS / MTS General Duty / MTS Aaya 18-27 Years

DSSSB Age Relaxation 2026

Category Relaxation
SC / ST 5 Years
OBC (Delhi) 3 Years
PwBD 10 Years
PwBD + SC/ST 15 Years

Ex-Servicemen Military Service Plus 3 Years, Subject to Maximum Age of 55 Years
Meritorious Sportspersons - Group C 5 Years; 8 for OBC and 10 for SC/ST
Eligible Departmental Employees As per Group B / Group C Service Rules
Eligible Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women Not Remarried - Group C Up to 35 Years; 38 for OBC and 40 for SC/ST

Important: OBC reservation and age relaxation are available only to candidates meeting DSSSB's notified OBC (Delhi) requirements. OBC candidates from outside Delhi are generally considered under the unreserved category for these benefits.

Age Relaxation for Contractual Employees

For specified NDMC, MCD, DUSIB and Directorate of Education positions, eligible contractual employees of the same department may receive one-time upper-age relaxation up to the actual period of contractual service, subject to a maximum of five years and the prescribed requirement of at least 180 working days in the relevant year.

This concession does not automatically apply to every applicant or department.

DSSSB JE and MTS Salary 2026

The salary depends on the post and department. MTS positions carry Pay Level 1, while Junior Engineer positions carry Pay Level 6 or Level 8.

DSSSB Junior Engineer Salary

Department Pay Level Pay Scale
NDMC Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400
Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board Pre-Revised Rs. 9,300 - Rs. 34,800 + Grade Pay Rs. 4,200 As Notified
MCD Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400
Delhi Transco Limited Level 8 Rs. 52,000 - Rs. 1,51,100
DUSIB Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400

DSSSB MTS Salary

Post Pay Level Pay Scale
MTS General Duty Level 1 Rs. 18,000 - Rs. 56,900
MTS Aaya (Female) Level 1 Rs. 18,000 - Rs. 56,900
Other Departmental MTS Level 1 Rs. 18,000 - Rs. 56,900

Salary Clarification: The figures represent notified pay scales, not take-home salary. Applicable allowances, benefits and deductions depend on Government and departmental service rules.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee is Rs. 100. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and eligible Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempt.

Category Application Fee
General / UR Rs. 100
OBC Rs. 100
EWS Rs. 100
SC / ST Exempted
Women Candidates Exempted
PwBD Exempted
Eligible Ex-Servicemen Exempted

Payment Mode: SBI e-pay only.

Important: Ex-Servicemen who have already obtained regular civil employment after using the applicable re-employment reservation benefits are not eligible for the stated fee concession. Application fees once paid are non-refundable.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

DSSSB will conduct separate combined examinations for Junior Engineer and MTS under their respective post codes.

Post Code Recruitment Examination Scheme
809/26 Junior Engineer (Electrical) Two-Tier Technical Examination
810/26 MTS / General Duty / Aaya One-Tier General Examination

The recruitment also involves online e-dossier submission, document verification and department/post allocation based on merit, eligibility, reservation and preferences. Skill, endurance, driving or trade tests may be conducted where required by the job.

DSSSB Junior Engineer Electrical Exam Pattern 2026

Junior Engineer candidates will appear in a Two-Tier Technical Examination. Tier-I is used for shortlisting, while Tier-II marks determine the final examination merit.

DSSSB JE Tier-I Exam Pattern

Section / Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 20 20
General Intelligence and Reasoning 20 20
Arithmetical and Numerical Ability 20 20
Hindi Language and Comprehension 20 20
English Language and Comprehension 20 20
Electrical Engineering / Domain Subject 100 100
Total 200 200
Exam Duration 2 Hours
Question Type Objective MCQ
Marks per Question 1
Negative Marking 0.25 per Wrong Answer

Tier-I Qualification: Minimum qualifying marks apply separately to Section B (Domain Subject) and to the combined marks of Sections A and B. There is no separate minimum qualifying requirement for Section A alone. Tier-I marks are used only for shortlisting to Tier-II.

DSSSB JE Tier-II Exam Pattern

Section Questions Marks
Part-I - Electrical Engineering Subject Knowledge 100 100
Part-II - Application of Concepts and Problem Solving 50 100
Total 150 200
Exam Duration 2 Hours 30 Minutes
Total Questions 150
Maximum Marks 200
Part-I Marks per Question 1
Part-II Marks per Question 2
Negative Marking 0.25 for Wrong 1-Mark Question; 0.50 for Wrong 2-Mark Question

Tier-II Merit: Candidates must meet the applicable minimum qualifying marks separately in Part-I and Part-II. The combined Tier-II score is used for preparing the final merit list.

DSSSB MTS Exam Pattern 2026

MTS candidates will appear for a One-Tier General Examination consisting of 200 objective questions for 200 marks.

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 40 40
General Intelligence and Reasoning Ability 40 40
Arithmetical and Numerical Ability 40 40
Hindi Language and Comprehension 40 40
English Language and Comprehension 40 40
Total 200 200
Examination Mode One-Tier General
Duration 2 Hours
Questions 200
Maximum Marks 200
Negative Marking 0.25 per Incorrect Answer
Final Merit One-Tier Examination Marks, Subject to Applicable Qualifying Standards

DSSSB Minimum Qualifying Marks 2026

The notification specifies the following minimum written examination qualifying percentages.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
General / UR 40%
EWS 40%
OBC (Delhi) 35%
SC / ST 30%
PwBD 30%
Ex-Servicemen 5% Relaxation in Respective Category, Subject to Minimum 30%

These are minimum qualifying standards, not guaranteed final selection cut-offs. The actual merit cut-off may be higher depending on examination performance, vacancies and category-wise competition.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Post Preference and Department Allocation

The notification provides a combined examination framework for each post code. Candidates who are shortlisted must submit their eligible department/post preferences when DSSSB opens the online e-dossier process.

  • At least one department/post preference must be submitted.
  • Preference submission takes place at the online e-dossier stage.
  • Only departments for which the candidate meets all essential conditions should be selected.
  • Preferences become final after confirmation.
  • Candidates who fail to submit preferences within the notified period will not be considered for nomination/selection.
  • Department allocation is based on merit, available vacancies, reservation and submitted preferences.
  • No waiting panel will be maintained under the combined examination scheme.

Important: Candidates cannot claim another department after being allocated their first available preference according to merit. The department preferences should therefore be selected carefully.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

Applications for Advertisement No. 06/2026 will be accepted through the official DSSSB Online Application Registration System (OARS).

Apply Online: DSSSB OARS Portal

Registration Start: 12 November 2026, 12:00 Noon.

Last Date: 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM.

Post Codes: 809/26 and 810/26.

Applicants who have already registered on OARS should use their existing registration credentials. Multiple registrations by the same candidate are prohibited.

How to Apply Online for DSSSB Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official application portal at dsssbonline.nic.in.
  2. Read Advertisement No. 06/2026 and confirm the applicable post-code eligibility.
  3. If you have previously registered on the DSSSB OARS portal, log in using your existing registration details.
  4. New candidates should select Click for New Registration.
  5. Enter the required personal information and Class 10 examination details.
  6. Provide an active email ID and mobile number.
  7. Complete the required verification and registration steps.
  8. Log in with the generated registration number and password.
  9. Open Advertisement No. 06/2026 and choose the relevant post code.
  10. Enter educational qualifications, experience and other required eligibility information.
  11. Enter reservation, category and age-relaxation information where applicable.
  12. Upload any documents requested during the application stage.
  13. Review the application form carefully before submission.
  14. Pay the prescribed Rs. 100 fee through SBI e-pay, if not exempt.
  15. Complete final submission before 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  16. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Important: Once an online application has been finally submitted, DSSSB does not permit changes or corrections, including changes to the candidate's category. Applicants should verify every detail before final submission.

DSSSB OARS New Registration Requirements

The notification provides separate instructions for candidates registering on the DSSSB OARS portal for the first time.

Particulars Requirement
Registration Type One-Time Registration
Official Portal dsssbonline.nic.in
Mobile Number Active and Valid
Email ID Active and Valid
Photo Identity Proof PAN / Voter ID / Driving Licence / Passport, as Applicable
Identity Proof Image Format JPG / JPEG
Identity Proof File Size 15 KB to 60 KB
Aadhaar-Based Registration Separate Scanned ID Upload Not Required When Aadhaar Number Is Used, as Specified

The OARS instructions specify minimum identity-document image dimensions depending on the type of card. Candidates should follow the official registration annexure and check the preview before final submission.

Documents Required for DSSSB Recruitment 2026

Applicants should keep relevant documents ready for registration, application submission and later e-dossier verification.

  • Class 10 / Matriculation certificate and marksheet.
  • Electrical Engineering degree or diploma, for applicable Junior Engineer positions.
  • Relevant electrical installation, maintenance or professional experience certificates where required.
  • ITI certificate, where applicable to the notified qualification route.
  • Valid photo identity proof.
  • SC/ST certificate, where applicable.
  • OBC (Delhi) Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable.
  • EWS Income and Asset Certificate for the prescribed financial year.
  • PwBD certificate, where applicable.
  • Ex-Servicemen service/discharge documents, where applicable.
  • Meritorious Sportsperson certificate, where applicable.
  • Documents supporting departmental or contractual-service age relaxation.
  • Other certificates required by the concerned department and DSSSB.

Important: The advertisement provides for online e-dossier submission after shortlisting. Candidates must upload supporting documents within the notified e-dossier period. Failure to do so may result in non-consideration of candidature.

DSSSB Reservation and Eligibility Rules 2026

Reservation is governed by the applicable Government of NCT of Delhi and Government of India instructions.

OBC Reservation

Only candidates satisfying the notified OBC (Delhi) conditions are entitled to the applicable OBC reservation and age-relaxation benefits. OBC candidates from outside Delhi do not automatically qualify for those benefits.

EWS Reservation

EWS applicants must possess the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate valid for financial year 2026-27, issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26.

Persons with Benchmark Disabilities

PwBD candidates must check whether their specific disability category is identified as suitable for the department and post. Suitability is not identical across all Junior Engineer departments.

Horizontal reservation figures are included in the published vacancy count and are not additional vacancies.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Admit Card and Examination Date

DSSSB has not announced the examination dates for Advertisement No. 06/2026 in the detailed notification.

The Board will publish examination schedules, admit card instructions and relevant recruitment updates through dsssb.delhi.gov.in.

Candidates should follow the official examination instructions and carry the required admit card and identity document to the allotted examination centre.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Advertisement No. 06/2026 announces 1260 vacancies.
  • Junior Engineer Post Code is 809/26 with 185 vacancies.
  • MTS Post Code is 810/26 with 1075 vacancies.
  • Applications open on 12 November 2026 at 12:00 noon.
  • The closing date is 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  • All eligibility is determined as on 11 December 2026.
  • MTS posts generally require Class 10/Matriculation.
  • Junior Engineer posts require the specified Electrical Engineering qualification.
  • Experience requirements differ by JE department.
  • MTS Aaya positions are notified for female candidates.
  • Only online applications are accepted.
  • OARS registration is a one-time exercise.
  • Multiple OARS registrations can result in cancellation and debarment.
  • No changes are permitted after final application submission.
  • Application fees are non-refundable.
  • JE recruitment follows a Two-Tier Technical Examination.
  • MTS recruitment follows a One-Tier General Examination.
  • Negative marking applies to incorrect answers.
  • Department preferences must be submitted at the e-dossier stage.
  • Original documents and eligibility will be verified by the concerned department.
  • Vacancies are tentative and may change.
  • Applicants should monitor the official DSSSB website for examination dates and corrigenda.

The Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank) has announced a recruitment drive for Management Trainee and Manager posts in 2026. The bank invites applications from eligible candidates for a total of 120 positions, including 90 Management Trainee and 30 Manager vacancies.

The short recruitment notice was published on 11 November 2026, and the last date for submitting applications is 11 December 2026. Interested candidates can visit the official Exim Bank careers website for the detailed advertisement, eligibility conditions and online application information.

  • Last Date for Apply Online: 11-12-2026
  • Written Examination Date: December 2026 (Tentative)

Exim Bank Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

India Exim Bank has announced 120 vacancies for Management Trainee and Manager positions. The recruitment includes 90 Management Trainee vacancies and 30 Manager vacancies. The post-wise details are provided below:

Post Name No. of Posts
Management Trainee (MT) 90
Manager 30
Total 120

By category, the 90 Management Trainee posts are UR 40, SC 07, ST 09, OBC (NCL) 25 and EWS 9 (including 03 PwBD). The 30 Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) posts are UR 15, SC 03, ST 02, OBC (NCL) 07 and EWS 03 (including 01 PwBD).

Who Can Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?

Candidates with relevant educational qualifications in management, finance, commerce and other professional disciplines may be eligible for Exim Bank Management Trainee and Manager positions. Final qualification and experience requirements should be checked against the detailed recruitment advertisement.

  • Management Trainee: Candidates with a relevant graduation degree along with MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS qualifications in Finance, International Business or Foreign Trade, or a Chartered Accountancy qualification, may be eligible. Previous MT recruitment rules required specified minimum marks. The exact requirements for this recruitment are yet to be confirmed. The detailed notification says most MT streams need at least 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in a 3-year full-time Graduation and a 2-year full-time Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or CA (ICAI membership mandatory). Streams such as Legal, Cyber Security, Digital Technology, Compliance, HR, Administration, ESG and Corporate Communications have their own qualifications.
  • Manager: Candidates with relevant graduation, postgraduate or professional qualifications and the required post-qualification work experience may be eligible. The detailed advertisement will specify the accepted qualifications and experience. The detailed notification says Manager posts need at least 60% marks in Graduation and a relevant Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) or CA, which varies by stream, plus at least 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

Note: Candidates should verify the prescribed qualification, minimum marks, experience and other eligibility conditions before submitting an application. Candidates appearing in their final qualifying examinations by May 2027 may also take the written examination. Post-graduation done through online / correspondence / part-time / distance mode is not accepted.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

  • Management Trainee: The previous recruitment eligibility range was 21 to 28 years. The age limit for the 2026 recruitment is subject to confirmation in the detailed notification. The detailed notification confirms it as not below 21 and not above 28 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Manager: The minimum and maximum age limits will be specified in the detailed notification. The detailed notification sets it at not below 24 and not above 30 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Age Relaxation: Applicable category-wise relaxation will be governed by the official recruitment rules. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL). For PwBD it is relaxed by 10 years (General/EWS), 13 years (OBC-NCL) and 15 years (SC/ST), and Ex-servicemen get up to 5 years.

The age calculation cutoff date and applicable relaxations should be verified from the detailed Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 notification.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • General / OBC Candidates: Rs. 600/- (Application fee and intimation charges)
  • SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female Candidates: Rs. 100/- (Intimation charges only)
  • Payment Mode: As specified in the official application instructions. Payment is online only (Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards / Mobile Wallets) from 27-11-2026 to 11-12-2026.

The category-wise application fee for this recruitment has not been confirmed in the short notice. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification before making any payment. The detailed notification now confirms the fee shown above, and fees once paid are non-refundable.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary

  • Management Trainee: Rs. 65,000/- monthly stipend during the one-year training. After training they are absorbed as Deputy Manager (JM-I) in the pay scale Rs. 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920 (CTC about Rs. 25 lakh a year).
  • Manager (MM-II): Rs. 64820-2340-67160-2680-93960 (CTC about Rs. 30 lakh a year).

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection will be through a Written Test and a Personal Interview. The written test is a subjective Professional Knowledge paper of 100 marks lasting 2 hours 30 minutes. Part I is a compulsory question or case study (40 marks) and in Part II candidates attempt any 6 of 8 questions (60 marks), all based on the selected specialization. The final selection is based on 70% weightage for the written test and 30% for the interview. The exam will be held in Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai and New Delhi, and interviews in Mumbai and / or New Delhi.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official India Exim Bank website at https://www.eximbankindia.in/.
  • Open the Careers section on the homepage.
  • Find the recruitment advertisement for Management Trainee and Manager posts.
  • Download and read the detailed notification carefully.
  • Check the required educational qualifications, age limit and experience conditions.
  • Open the official online application link when available (the link will be live from 27 November 2026).
  • Complete the registration process using the required personal and contact details.
  • Fill in the application form with accurate educational, personal and professional information.
  • Upload the required documents, photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as instructed.
  • Pay the application fee, if applicable.
  • Submit the completed application form by 11 December 2026 and save a copy for future reference.

Applicants must possess the prescribed post-specific educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions by the application closing date.

Library Assistant A First Class Graduation and First Class Master's Degree in Library Science, Library and Information Science or recognized equivalent
Nurse B First Class Diploma in Nursing of at least three years, recognized by State/Central Government, with registration in the respective State Nursing Council
Technician B SSLC/SSC Pass with ITI/NTC/NAC from NCVT in the notified trade

Technician B Trade Qualifications

Technician B applicants must have the NCVT trade qualification corresponding to their selected post code.

Important: Boiler Attendant applicants must possess both the prescribed NAC in Boiler Attendant trade and a First Class Boiler Attendant Certificate. A general ITI certificate alone does not meet this specific requirement.

Driver Experience Requirements

For Light Vehicle Driver A and Heavy Vehicle Driver A posts, the prescribed experience must have been gained after obtaining a valid driving licence.

These approximate monthly figures represent basic pay plus DA at the minimum pay level. HRA and Transport Allowance are governed by applicable Government of India rules. Other benefits are subject to ISRO service conditions.

The notification prescribes different processing fees according to the post code. All applicants must initially pay the specified processing fee online.

Post Codes Initial Payment Refund for Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen Attending Written Test Refund for Other Candidates Attending Written Test
07–15 Rs. 750 Rs. 750 Rs. 500
16–30 Rs. 500 Rs. 500 Rs. 400

For post codes 07–15, the effective application fee after refund is Rs. 250 for other candidates and nil for the exempt categories. For post codes 16–30, it is Rs. 100 for other candidates and nil for the exempt categories, provided they appear in the written examination and meet the refund conditions.

Important Fee Refund Condition: The refund is available only to candidates who appear in the Written Test. Candidates absent from the examination will not receive a refund. Applicants must enter their bank account details accurately to receive any eligible refund.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Selection Process 2026

The selection procedure differs according to the notified post.

Post Category Selection Stages
Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant A Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Technician B and Draughtsman B Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Nurse B Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Fireman A Written Test, Physical Efficiency Test and Detailed Medical Examination
Light Vehicle Driver A / Heavy Vehicle Driver A Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Multi-Tasking Staff Written Test

For posts with qualifying skill or physical tests, the final merit is prepared according to the written examination performance of candidates who qualify in the required subsequent stages.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Exam Pattern 2026

Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant A, Technician B and Draughtsman B

Total Questions 80 MCQs
Written Test Duration 90 Minutes
Maximum Marks 80
Correct Answer +1 Mark
Incorrect Answer -0.33 Mark
Skill Test 100 Marks, Qualifying Nature

The minimum written-test qualifying marks are 32 out of 80 for unreserved candidates and 24 out of 80 for eligible candidates against reserved posts. The minimum qualifying marks for the skill test are 50 out of 100 for unreserved candidates and 40 out of 100 for eligible candidates against reserved posts.

Nurse B and Fireman A Written Test

Total Questions 80 MCQs
Duration 120 Minutes
Maximum Marks 80
Correct Answer +1 Mark
Incorrect Answer -0.33 Mark

Nurse B candidates must qualify in the prescribed skill test. Fireman A candidates must qualify in the Physical Efficiency Test and Detailed Medical Examination under the standards specified in the advertisement.

Light Vehicle Driver and Heavy Vehicle Driver Written Test

Subject Questions
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 50
Elementary English - 8th Standard Level 15
Elementary Arithmetic - 10th Standard Level 15

Total 100

The examination duration is 120 minutes, with one mark for each correct answer and a deduction of 0.25 mark for each incorrect answer. The subsequent driving skill test is qualifying in nature.

Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Exam Pattern

Total Questions 100
Total Marks 100
Duration 90 Minutes
Negative Marking 0.25 Mark per Incorrect Answer

The MTS examination covers Numerical and Mathematical Ability, Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving, General Awareness, and English Language and Comprehension.

Applicants for posts with multiple notified locations must provide their order of posting preference. Allocation is based on merit, preference and vacancy availability. Selected candidates are also subject to all-India transfer liability within ISRO/Department of Space.

How to Apply for ISRO SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official SDSC SHAR website at www.shar.gov.in or the application portal at apps.shar.gov.in.
  2. Open Advertisement No. SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026.
  3. Read the detailed notification and identify the post code matching your qualifications.
  4. Open the online application and enter the required personal, educational and contact information.
  5. Provide a valid email address and mobile number.
  6. Select the relevant post code and posting preferences, where applicable.
  7. Upload the photograph, signature and required supporting documents according to the portal specifications.
  8. Review all application details carefully.
  9. Pay the applicable processing fee through the online payment facility.
  10. Complete the application submission by 16 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  11. Save the generated Registration Number and application details for future reference.

Multiple Post Codes: Candidates eligible for more than one post code must submit separate applications and pay the prescribed fee separately for each post code.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

There are 33 Trainee Engineer (Electronics) posts in PowerTel (POWERGRID Teleservice Limited), to be filled on the basis of GATE 2026 (EC paper). Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID), a 'Maharatna' Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, is carrying out this recruitment on behalf of its wholly owned subsidiary PowerTel under Advertisement No. CC/04/2026 dated 13.11.2026. Selected candidates train for one year in the pay scale of Rs.30,000 -1,20,000/-. Online applications on the POWERGRID website (powergrid.in) open on 13 November 2026 at 17 00 Hrs and close on 27 November 2026 at 23 59 Hrs.

POWERGRID Trainee Engineer (Electronics) Quick Facts

Particulars Details
Establishment PowerTel (POWERGRID Teleservice Limited), recruitment by POWERGRID
Advertisement No. CC/04/2026
Vacancies 33 (Post ID - 569)
Discipline Electronics
Pay During Training Rs.30,000 -1,20,000/-, IDA, HRA and Perks @ 12% of Basic Pay per month
Training Period One year
Who Can Apply Electronics engineering graduates with minimum 60% marks who qualified GATE 2026 (EC)
Age Limit 18 years or above; upper age limit 28 years as on 27.11.2026
Apply At Online on the POWERGRID website, www.powergrid.in
Last Date 27.11.2026 (23 59 Hrs)

About POWERGRID and PowerTel

Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd. (POWERGRID) is a 'Maharatna' Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, engaged in power transmission, especially in the inter-State segment. PowerTel (POWERGRID Teleservice Limited) is its wholly owned subsidiary. PowerTel provides telecom services such as point to point links, MPLS-VPN services and internet services using the optical fibre (OPGW) network on POWERGRID's extra high voltage transmission lines, covering 108,000+ km and 4,500+ locations.

The notice states that PowerTel has Network and Security Operating Centres at New Delhi, a backup Control Centre at Bengaluru, and four Regional Control Centres at Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Kolkata, along with offices across the country. It is also setting up a Pilot Data Centre in Manesar (near Gurgaon) and a Zone-II Data Centre in Southern India. The Trainee Engineers are being recruited for PowerTel's various offices across the country.

Seats by Trade (Category-wise Vacancies)

All 33 vacancies are in the Electronics discipline (Post ID - 569). The total includes horizontal reservation.

Discipline UR OBC (NCL) SC ST EWS Total
Electronics (Post ID - 569) 14 07 06 03 03 33

PwBD Reservation

Vacancies PwBD Category Reservation
01 Interchangeable (IC): first filled by LD; if no suitable LD candidate, other identified suitable sub-categories are considered
01 Hearing Impaired

Only the following PwBD sub-categories are identified as suitable and eligible to apply:

  • Hearing Impaired: Deaf, Hard of hearing
  • Locomotor Disability: One Arm, One Leg, Spinal Deformity & Spinal Injury (SI) without any associated neurological / limb dysfunction, Spinal Deformity (SD) and Spinal Injury (SI) with associated limb dysfunction, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victim
  • Intellectual Disabilities: Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness
  • Multiple Disabilities: Multiple Disability involving the above

Who Can Apply

Qualification

Requirement Details
Essential Qualification Full Time B.E./ B.Tech/ B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electronics discipline or equivalent from recognized University/ Institute with minimum 60% marks or Equivalent CGPA
Discipline Electronics/ Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication/ Electronics & Electrical Communication / Telecommunication Engg
GATE 2026 Paper EC

Candidates must have appeared in the EC paper of GATE 2026 and qualified in it with a valid score; the qualifying marks declared by the GATE 2026 Organizing Body will be considered. Only the GATE 2026 score (Normalized Marks out of 100) is valid for this recruitment.

  • The essential qualification must be recognised in India and from a recognised Institution or University.
  • The date of issue of the final mark sheet is taken as the date of acquiring the essential qualification.
  • Where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA or a letter grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage must be entered in the form as per the norms of the University/Institute. If there is no conversion scheme, CGPA is divided by the maximum possible CGPA and multiplied by 100.
  • Marks in the essential qualification will not be rounded off.
  • Qualifying marks in the essential qualification are relaxed to pass marks for posts reserved for the respective category.
  • All computations of age and qualification are as on the closing date of online application; the cut-off date for eligibility is 27.11.2026.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

Age

Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years or above are eligible. The upper age limit is 28 years as on 27.11.2026.

Category Relaxation in Upper Age Limit
OBC (NCL) 3 years (Subject to reservation of post)
SC/ST 5 years (Subject to reservation of post)
PwBD 10 years over and above category relaxation
Victims of riots As per Govt. of India directives

Who Cannot Apply

  • Candidates who are not Indian Nationals.
  • PwBD candidates outside the identified suitable sub-categories listed above; PwBD benefit is only for persons with not less than 40% of the relevant disability.
  • Candidates not meeting the specified criteria will not be considered; applications in which the essential qualification or age cannot be fully ascertained are liable for rejection.

Reservation

Reservation, relaxation and concession for reserved categories, including PwBD, are as per Government of India directives, subject to these certificates:

  • OBC (NCL): latest OBC (NCL) certificate in the Government of India format for "Appointment to posts under Govt. of India", based on income for FY 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 and issued on/after 01.04.2026, at application and interview, if called for.
  • EWS: Income and Asset Certificate based on income for FY 2025-2026 and issued on/after 01.04.2026, with the caste name clearly mentioned ("General / Samanya" will not suffice).
  • SC/ST: Caste Certificate in the Government of India format at application and every stage of recruitment.
  • PwD/PwBD: medical certificate of permanent disability issued by the Government Medical Board, and the UDID card/certificate.
  • Victims of riots: Age relaxation cum Domicile certificate issued by a Competent Authority.
  • OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must belong to the category and hold a valid certificate as on the closing date of online application.
  • A certificate in a language other than Hindi or English needs a certified Hindi or English translation at Document Verification, if called for.
  • Candidates of reserved categories may apply against unreserved posts if they meet the general standards of eligibility.

Stipend and Training Period

Stage Pay / Designation
Training (one year) Pay scale of Rs.30,000 -1,20,000/-, IDA, HRA and Perks @ 12% of Basic Pay per month
After successful training Asst. Engineer at E0 level, pay scale of Rs.30,000 -1,20,000/- (IDA)
CTC per annum (approx.) Rs. 14.33 lakh (approx.)

On regularisation, the compensation package includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Perquisites and Allowance as per cafeteria approach, Company Quarters or HRA, Location Based Compensatory Allowance (as applicable), Performance Related Pay, Terminal Benefits (Provident Fund, Gratuity, Pension, PRMB – Post Retirement Medical Benefits), EDLI, Group Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, reimbursement of Monthly Conveyance, Mobile & Digital Services, Leave encashment and TA/DA. PowerTel also offers Conveyance Advance, Multi-Purpose Advance and medical facilities for self and dependents to regular employees as per its policies from time to time.

Career Progression

Level Eligibility Period
E0 to E1 05 years (excluding training period)
E1 to E2 & above upto E6 05 years

Service Agreement Bond

Selected candidates must execute a service agreement bond to serve for a minimum of three years after successful completion of training: Rs.5,00,000/- for General/ OBC (NCL)/ EWS candidates and Rs.2,50,000/- for SC/ ST/ PwBD candidates.

How to Apply for POWERGRID Trainee Engineer (Electronics)

Applications are accepted only online on the POWERGRID website https://www.powergrid.in; any other mode is not accepted, and no hard copy is to be sent.

  1. Keep a valid e-mail ID, an alternate e-mail ID and a mobile number ready (mandatory), and keep them active for at least one year.
  2. Register online at https://www.powergrid.in with your GATE-2026 Application No, GATE 2026 Registration number and other required details, even if you have applied to POWERGRID before.
  3. Enter your name and other details exactly as in your GATE-2026 Admit Card/ Score Card; the GATE Registration No. and Name cannot be changed after submission.
  4. Enter qualification details, including the date of acquiring the qualification, and your bank details (account number, bank name, branch, IFSC) for online TA payment, if applicable.
  5. Upload the documents listed below and click Submit; the system generates a unique Registration Number.
  6. Non-exempted candidates log in to the candidate login and pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/- online by 27.11.2026 (23 59 Hrs); the application is complete only after payment.
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application (needed at Document Verification) and note the user ID, password and Registration Number.

Application Fee

Category Fee
Candidates not exempted Rs. 500/- (non-refundable)
SC/ST/PwBD/Departmental candidates Exempted

The fee is paid online through the candidate login and is non-refundable even if the candidature is rejected. Applications without the fee (where applicable) and incomplete or draft applications will be rejected.

Documents to Upload

Document Size (Max) / Format
Recent passport size colour photograph (white background) 50 KB, .jpg
Signature (in Blue/ Black Ink) 50 KB, .jpg
Date of Birth Proof: Matric / Birth Certificate 03 MB, .pdf
Degree certificate with mark sheets of all years/semesters and CGPA conversion norms (if applicable), all in one pdf 10 MB, .pdf
No-Objection Certificate (candidates working in Govt. / PSU, applying through proper channel) 03 MB, .pdf
Caste Certificate/EWS Certificate (if applicable) 03 MB, .pdf
PwBD Certificate (if applicable) 03 MB, .pdf
Scribe certificate for PwBD/PwD candidates regarding physical limitation to write (if required) 03 MB, .pdf
Photo ID proof of scribe (if required) 03 MB, .pdf
Domicile cum Age relaxation certificate for riot victims (if applicable) 03 MB, .pdf

Keep spare copies of the same photograph used in the online registration. Originals of all uploaded documents must be produced at document verification / medical / joining, if called for.

Selection Process

Selection consists of normalized GATE 2026 marks (out of 100) in the EC paper, Behavioural Assessment, Group Discussion and Personal Interview, followed by a Pre-Employment Medical Examination for appointment.

Shortlisting on GATE 2026 Marks

Candidates are shortlisted for Behavioural Assessment, Group Discussion and Personal Interview based only on their normalized marks out of 100 in GATE 2026 (EC) and as per criteria decided by the Management. Status and interview call letters are available through the candidate login.

Behavioural Assessment, Group Discussion and Interview

Shortlisted candidates may have to undergo a Behavioural Assessment, whose results are used as an input during the interview. Candidates can take the GD/interview in Hindi or English. Group Discussion has no qualifying marks, but the Personal Interview must be qualified:

Vacancy Qualifying % in Interview
UR Vacancy including EWS 40%
Reserved Vacancy 30% (Subject to reservation of post)

Final Score Weightage

Parameter Weightage
GATE 2026 Marks (out of 100) 85%
Group Discussion 3%
Personal Interview 12%

Offers of appointment are issued in order of category-wise merit and based on requirement. Candidates with equal marks are empanelled by date of birth, the oldest first. Appointment is subject to medical fitness in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination as per POWERGRID Norms and Standards of Medical Fitness.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement date 13.11.2026
Commencement of online application and online fee payment 13.11.2026 (17 00 Hrs)
Last date of online application and online fee payment 27.11.2026 (23 59 Hrs)
Cut-off date for eligibility criteria 27.11.2026

Important Instructions

  • Submit only one application for the post; it can be edited until the last date of online submission but not after.
  • Bring a valid original photo ID, the GATE 2026 admit card and the original GATE 2026 score card to the GD/interview; candidates without them will not be permitted to appear. Photocopies of the ID are not accepted.
  • Candidates working in Govt. / PSU must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of Interview.
  • Candidates are liable to be posted at the discretion of PowerTel management anywhere in India or abroad, at company offices or other government departments, statutory bodies or PSUs.
  • Candidates on the rolls of PowerTel have no claim on absorption/employment in POWERGRID or its other subsidiary/JV companies.
  • Candidates must meet POWERGRID's health standards before applying; details are in the career section of www.powergrid.in.
  • Candidature is provisional at all stages; the Management reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge or modify the process and to raise or lower qualifying standards.
  • Updates are published only in the career section of the POWERGRID website; queries go to [email protected] with "Trainee Engineer 2026 for PowerTel ____________" in the subject line. Complaints made through the Complaint Management System will not be entertained.
  • Legal jurisdiction is NCT of Delhi.

The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable online transaction charges, if any, must be paid by the candidate.

RRC NR Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection for RRC NR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit calculated from Class 10 and ITI marks. There will be no written examination or interview.

  • Screening and scrutiny of online applications.
  • Preparation of merit lists based on the average percentage of Class 10 and ITI marks, with equal weightage.
  • Document verification of shortlisted candidates.
  • Fulfilment of prescribed medical fitness requirements.

Merit Calculation: (Class 10 Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2

If two candidates receive the same merit score, preference will be given to the older candidate. If their dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.

RRC NR Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a stipend during their training according to the applicable Apprenticeship Rules. The official RRC NR notification does not specify a fixed monthly stipend amount for each trade.

Apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment in Northern Railway after completion of the training period.

How to Apply Online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the official website before 11 December 2026.

  1. Visit the official Northern Railway RRC website at www.rrcnr.org.
  2. Find the Engagement of Act Apprentice 2026 online application link.
  3. Complete registration using your personal details, mobile number and email ID.
  4. Log in using the registration credentials.
  5. Enter the required personal, educational and ITI qualification details.
  6. Select the appropriate cluster and unit based on the available slots for your ITI trade.
  7. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and certificates.
  8. Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
  9. Review the details and submit the application form.
  10. Download and print the submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Important: Only one application is permitted per candidate. Multiple applications may lead to rejection, and changes are not allowed after final submission.

The online application and the fee payment window both run from 7 November 2026 to 26 November 2026. The dates of the examinations, call letters, interview and provisional selection will be notified separately by the Bank.

Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. has issued the "Recruitment of Probationary Officers – UT of J&K" notice for 323 posts of Probationary Officer, with online examinations to be conducted by IBPS.

Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. is a bank with its Corporate Headquarters at M.A. Road, Srinagar. Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. has notified a total of 323 vacancies for the post of Probationary Officer.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Category-wise Vacancy 2026

The notice gives reservation as percentages, not as the number of posts in each category. Reservation follows the Union territory of Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Rules, 2005, as amended from time to time, and S.O. 176 dated March 15, 2024, issued by the Social Welfare Department, Civil Secretariat, J&K.

Category Reservation
Scheduled Castes 8%
Scheduled Tribes – existing list (Bakarwal, Balti, Beda, Bot/Boto, Brokpa/Drokpa/Dard/Shin, Changpa, Garra, Gaddi, Gujjar, Mon, Purigpa, Sippi) 10% (of 20% for Scheduled Tribes)
Scheduled Tribes – added in 2024 (Gadda Brahmin, Koli, Paddari Tribe, Pahari Ethnic Group) 10% (of 20% for Scheduled Tribes)

Residents of Backward Areas 10%
Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) 10%
Persons with Disabilities 4% (Horizontal Reservation)

Reservation for Persons with Disabilities

Under section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, the 4% reservation is divided as follows:

Disability Reservation
Blindness or low vision 1%
Deaf and Hard of hearing 1%
Locomotor disability including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy 1%
Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness 1%

Multiple disabilities from amongst the above, including deaf-blindness, are also covered. Only persons with benchmark disability (not less than 40% of a specified disability) are eligible for reservation, and they must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority. PwBD candidates whose certificate shows the condition as "likely to improve" under the temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation; conditions marked "Progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" are treated as eligible.

  • A reserved category candidate who figures in the general list on own merit will not be adjusted against a reserved post; the original category stays unchanged.
  • Unfilled EWS vacancies will be filled as per the reservation rules of the UT of J&K.
  • A valid reserved category certificate must be held on the date of online registration.
  • The EWS certificate should be valid for the year 2026-2027.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Qualification Required
Probationary Officer Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by Government of India or any other equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government/UGC, as on the last date of registration.
  • Domicile: only domiciles of the UT of J&K are eligible; selected candidates must submit the domicile certificate issued by the competent authority.
  • The candidate must hold a valid marks sheet/degree certificate showing graduation as on the last date of registration (26 November 2026).
  • The percentage of marks in Graduation, calculated to the nearest two decimals, must be entered while registering online. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage, backed by a certificate from the appropriate authority on the University's conversion norms.
  • Percentage is total marks in all subjects of all semesters/years divided by aggregate maximum marks (including honours/optional/additional optional subjects) multiplied by 100. Fractions are ignored: 59.99% is treated as less than 60%.
  • A self-declaration of character and antecedents in a prescribed format is required. Candidature or appointment may be cancelled for material misrepresentation or conviction in a criminal offence involving moral turpitude.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Probationary Officer post.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Age Limit 2026

The age limit is minimum 20 years and maximum 30 years as on 01-01-2026, that is, a candidate must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996 and not later than 01.01.2006 (both dates inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General and EWS candidates.

The upper age relaxation for SC/ST/Socially and Educationally Backward candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with the relaxation for Persons with Disabilities.

Category Fee

All others Rs. 1200/- (excluding GST)
