Bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate. Registration is complete only when the fee is successfully deposited. If no e-Receipt is generated, the payment has failed and the candidate must log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Selection Process 2026

  1. Online Preliminary Examination
  2. Online Mains Examination (Objective & Descriptive)
  3. Interview

Preliminary Examination

Candidates must qualify in each of the three tests by securing cut-off marks decided by IBPS in concurrence with J&K Bank. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category candidates, subject to overall merit. Candidates numbering 10 times the vacancies in each category are shortlisted for the Mains.

Mains Examination

Each candidate needs a minimum score in each test and a minimum total score. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category, subject to overall merit. Only Mains marks count for shortlisting, and candidates numbering 3 times the vacancies in each category are called for interview. Mains scores are not shared before the interview process is completed.

Interview

The interview carries 100 marks, with minimum qualifying marks of 40% (35% for reserved category). The centre, venue, time and date will be given in the interview call letter, downloaded from https://jkb.bank.in/. The final merit score combines the Mains and the interview in the ratio 80:20, and candidates must qualify in both. Provisional selection is by category-wise merit against the vacancies in each category and will be notified on the Bank's website.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Exam Pattern 2026

Preliminary Examination

Test Questions Marks Time
English Language 30 30 20 Minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 35 30 20 Minutes
Reasoning Ability 35 40 20 Minutes
Total 100 100 60 Minutes

Mains Examination (Objective & Descriptive)

Test Questions Marks Time
Reasoning 40 60 45 minutes
General/ Economy/ Banking Awareness/ Digital/ Financial Awareness, including RBI Circulars 50 60 35 minutes
English Language 40 20 35 minutes
Data Analysis & Interpretation 40 60 45 minutes

Descriptive Paper (Essay & Comprehension) 2 25 30 minutes
  • The medium of examination is English, and each test is separately timed.
  • The Descriptive Paper may be broadly based on economic and social issues, emerging trends in banking and technology, current events and ethics.
  • Negative marking: one fourth of the marks of a question is deducted for each wrong answer in the objective tests of both the Preliminary and Mains. No penalty for a blank question.
  • Scores from different sessions are normalized using the equi-percentile method, taken up to two decimal points.
  • J&K Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website.

Examination Centres

Candidates must choose six centres, of which at least three must be outside J&K-UT. Any other centre may also be allotted.

Region Centres
Within J&K-UT Pulwama, Jammu, Srinagar, Baramulla, Samba
Outside J&K-UT Delhi NCR, Patiala, Mohali, Mumbai/ Navi Mumbai/ Thane, Amritsar, Pathankot, Jalandhar, Pune, Ludhiana, Bengaluru, Phagwara, Others if need arise

How to Apply Online for J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications are accepted online only from 07.11.2026 to 26.11.2026; no other mode is accepted. Before starting, keep scanned copies of the photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20kb–50kb, 200 x 230 pixels preferred), signature in black ink (not in capital letters), left thumb impression on white paper, and the hand-written declaration in English, plus an active personal email ID and mobile number.

  1. Go to https://jkb.bank.in/, open the relevant notification under the "Careers" tab and click "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id; note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent by Email and SMS.
  3. Validate the details and save with "Save & Next"; the form can be completed in more than one sitting.
  4. Upload the photograph and signature as per specifications, and capture a live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Fill the other details of the application form, then preview the whole form.
  6. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after checking everything; no change is possible after this.
  7. Click the "Payment" tab, pay the fee online and click "Submit".
  8. Print the e-Receipt and the online Application Form containing fee details.

The hand-written declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." A declaration written by anyone else or in another language makes the application invalid. Visually Impaired candidates who cannot write may type it and put their left thumb impression below.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Selected candidates must remain posted within the Zone first allotted for at least 5 years; no transfer outside that Zone is permitted on any ground before then.
  • No change of category is permitted after registration, and requests to be considered under another category will not be entertained.
  • Names of the candidate and father/husband must match the certificates, mark sheets and identity proof.
  • Entry to the Preliminary and Mains needs the call letter and original photo identity proof with a photocopy; Mains candidates must also bring the stamped Preliminary call letter and stamped ID copy.
  • Accepted ID proofs include PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, college/university ID, Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar with photograph or Employee ID; Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted.
  • Bring one additional photograph with the Preliminary call letter; keeping about 8 copies of the uploaded photograph is advised for later stages.
  • Late reporting after the time on the call letter bars entry; biometric data is captured at the Mains, document verification and joining.
  • Original documents (category, domicile, age, qualification) with photocopies are produced at document verification; candidature is cancelled without them at the interview.
  • Scribe users need the Appendix I certificate (uploaded with the application) and Appendix II undertaking; eligible candidates get 20 minutes compensatory time per hour if registered for it while applying.

Can 10th Pass Candidates Apply for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Class 10 pass candidates can apply for certain posts, including Rifleman (Armourer) and Rifleman (Mason). Other trades require additional ITI certificates or specified school subjects.

Can 12th Pass Candidates Apply?

Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 12 can apply for eligible positions such as Warrant Officer (Cipher), Havildar (Instrument Repairer/Mechanic), Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist, provided they possess the additional trade-specific qualifications.

Can ITI Certificate Holders Apply?

Yes. Several technical trades require ITI qualifications, including Electrician, Motor Mechanic, Welder, Metalsmith, Upholster, Engineer Equipment Mechanic and Recovery Vehicle Mechanic.

The applicant's ITI trade must correspond to the qualification specified for the selected post.

Is Domicile Certificate Mandatory?

Yes. Candidates must possess a valid Domicile or Permanent Residential Certificate issued by the competent authority.

The notification states that candidates must enter the correct domicile State/UT while applying. They will not be allowed to change that State during document verification.

Assam Rifles Trade Skill Test 2026

The Trade Skill Test assesses the practical skills required for the selected technical or tradesman position.

The notification specifies that the Trade Skill Test consists of a Computer-Based Practical Skill Test and a Trade-Specific Practical Skill Test, as applicable.

The test is qualifying in nature, and no marks are awarded for the Trade Skill Test in the final merit calculation.

How Are Candidates Shortlisted for the Trade Skill Test?

Shortlisting is based on CBT merit in the relevant trade and category. Candidates who qualify the Trade Skill Test proceed to the applicable document verification and medical examination.

The notification specifies shortlisting of approximately four candidates per vacancy for the subsequent document verification and medical assessment process, subject to the applicable trade and category provisions.

AFCAT 1 2027 Notification: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT 01/2027) notification for recruitment of men and women as Group 'A' Gazetted Officers in Flying and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) branches. The notification includes 284 fixed-number vacancies through AFCAT and GATE Score Entry, along with NCC Special Entry seats determined by the prescribed percentage of Flying Branch vacancies. Candidates with relevant graduation, engineering or postgraduate qualifications can apply according to branch-specific eligibility requirements. The age limit is 20 to 24 years for Flying Branch and 20 to 26 years for Ground Duty branches, as on 1 January 2028, with the notified Commercial Pilot Licence relaxation. Selected candidates will receive a starting basic pay of Rs. 56,100 under Pay Level 10 after commissioning. Online applications are open from 12 November 2026 at 11:00 AM to 11 December 2026 at 11:30 PM through afcat.edcil.co.in.

Latest Update: The AFCAT 01/2027 online examination is scheduled for 31 January 2027. Admit cards will be available from 27 January 2027 at 11:00 AM. The recruitment covers Permanent Commission (PC) and Short Service Commission (SSC) opportunities, with training scheduled to begin in January 2028. Applicants must check their age, educational qualifications and medical eligibility before applying.

AFCAT 1 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must be Indian citizens and meet the prescribed educational, age, marital-status and medical requirements for their selected entry and branch.

AFCAT Flying Branch Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed Mathematics and Physics at the 10+2 level and possess one of the following qualifications:

  • Graduation of at least three years in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • Four-year BE/B.Tech degree from a recognized university.
  • Cleared Section A and B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India) or Aeronautical Society of India, as prescribed.

Important: Mathematics and Physics at the 10+2 level are mandatory for the Flying Branch. Candidates must also satisfy the applicable age and medical standards.

Ground Duty Technical Qualification - AE(L)

Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) candidates must have passed Physics and Mathematics at the 10+2 level and possess a recognized eligible engineering/technology qualification or one of the alternative qualifications specifically accepted in the notification.

Eligible degree disciplines include various Electronics, Electrical, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Instrumentation, Robotics and related engineering specializations.

The detailed notification also provides an alternative route involving M.Sc. Electronics with B.Sc. Physics and specified professional engineering examinations.

Candidates must check the exact accepted discipline in Paragraph 5.3.2.1 before applying.

Ground Duty Technical Qualification - AE(M)

Aeronautical Engineer (Mechanical) applicants must have passed Physics and Mathematics at the 10+2 level and completed a recognized four-year engineering/technology qualification or the specified equivalent professional examination route.

Accepted engineering disciplines include Mechanical, Aeronautical, Aerospace, Automobile, Production, Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Metallurgical and related specializations listed in the notification.

Can Final-Year Students Apply for AFCAT 1 2027?

Yes. Candidates studying in the final year or semester of their qualifying degree can apply if they have no current backlog when submitting their application.

They must provide proof of completion of their final examinations by 30 November 2027, under the conditions of the notification.

Can Diploma Candidates Apply Instead of 12th Pass?

No. The notification specifically states that candidates must have completed Class 12 under the 10+2 examination pattern. A diploma in place of 10+2 does not satisfy this condition.

The Flying Branch relaxation up to 26 years applies only to candidates holding a valid and current Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA (India).

AFCAT Marital Status Requirement

Candidates must be unmarried when the training course begins. Marriage is not permitted during training. Candidates who marry during training are liable to be discharged and required to refund Government expenditure incurred on their training.

AFCAT 1 2027 Selection Process

Selection depends on the entry route. AFCAT Entry candidates must qualify in the written examination before AFSB testing, while NCC Special Entry candidates are exempt from the AFCAT written test.

  1. Online application and initial eligibility verification.
  2. AFCAT written examination for AFCAT Entry candidates.
  3. AFSB testing for shortlisted eligible candidates.
  4. Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS), where applicable to Flying Branch.
  5. Medical examination according to Indian Air Force standards.
  6. Final merit list based on the applicable entry and selection criteria.
  7. Branch allocation according to merit, medical fitness, vacancies and preferences.
  8. Training at the designated Air Force training establishment.

The standard of Numerical Ability questions is Matriculation level, while the other subjects are generally of graduation level.

The notification specifies 100 questions for 300 marks across the combined syllabus; it does not provide a fixed subject-wise question distribution.

AFCAT 1 2027 AFSB Interview and Testing

Candidates qualifying under the relevant entry route will be called for Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing.

AFSB assessment involves Officer Intelligence Rating and psychological, group and interview assessments according to the prescribed testing stages.

Flying Branch candidates may additionally be required to qualify in the Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS).

Candidates who previously failed CPSS or were suspended from Flying Training at Air Force Academy are not eligible for the Flying Branch under the notification.

AFCAT Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by AFSB must satisfy the prescribed Indian Air Force physical and medical standards.

The requirements differ by Flying, Ground Duty Technical and Ground Duty Non-Technical branches.

For Flying Branch training, the notification additionally requires a minimum nude body weight of 48 kg before commencing Stage-I fixed-wing flying training.

Candidates should review the complete height, weight, vision and other medical standards contained in Appendix A of the official notification.

AFCAT NCC Special Entry 2027

NCC Special Entry provides eligible NCC Air Wing certificate holders an alternative route to Flying Branch selection.

Applicants must possess an NCC Air Wing Senior Division 'C' Certificate acquired within the prescribed two-year period preceding the AFCAT registration date.

Eligible NCC Special Entry candidates are exempt from the AFCAT written examination and are called directly for AFSB testing.

They must still satisfy the educational, age, marital-status and medical requirements for Flying Branch.

AFCAT GATE Score Entry 2027

GATE Score Entry is available for eligible Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) and Aeronautical Engineer (Mechanical) candidates.

Candidates must possess a completed BE/B.Tech qualification in one of the accepted engineering disciplines and qualify in the corresponding prescribed GATE subject.

The GATE result declaration date must fall between 1 January 2024 and 31 December 2027, as specified in the notification.

Applicants must provide their GATE score details and supporting qualification records. The entry is subject to the applicable shortlisting and AFSB selection procedures.

AFCAT Permanent Commission and Short Service Commission

Commission Type Service Conditions
Permanent Commission Service Until Applicable Superannuation Age, Subject to Service Rules
Flying Branch SSC 14 Years from Commissioning
Ground Duty SSC Initial 10 Years; Possible 4-Year Extension

The extension of Ground Duty SSC service is subject to vacancies, service requirements, willingness, merit and suitability.

The notification also states that SSC officers are not entitled to pension under the applicable commission terms. Grant of Permanent Commission at a later date is not automatic.

AFCAT 1 2027 Apply Online

Eligible candidates can apply online through the official AFCAT application portal between 12 November and 11 December 2026.

Apply Online: AFCAT Official Application Portal

Application Start: 12 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

Last Date: 11 December 2026 at 11:30 PM.

Important: Aadhaar details are mandatory for online registration. Applicants should verify their personal, educational and branch-preference information carefully before final submission because changes are not permitted after the applicable submission/payment stage.

How to Apply Online for AFCAT 1 2027?

  1. Visit the official website afcat.edcil.co.in.
  2. Read the AFCAT 01/2027 notification and application instructions.
  3. Select the new registration or sign-up option.
  4. Enter your full name as recorded in the Class 10 certificate.
  5. Provide your mobile number and email address.
  6. Generate and verify the OTPs sent separately to the registered mobile number and email.
  7. Complete the required declaration and registration verification.
  8. Receive the Application Sequence Number/User ID and password.
  9. Log in and open the application form.
  10. Select the appropriate entry category: AFCAT, NCC Special Entry or GATE Score Entry.
  11. Enter personal information, date of birth, identification and contact details.
  12. Provide the required permanent and correspondence addresses.
  13. Enter Class 12, graduation and postgraduate qualification details, as applicable.
  14. Provide NCC, GATE, CPL or other special-entry information where required.
  15. Select eligible course and branch preferences.
  16. Choose the permitted examination city preferences.
  17. Upload the recent photograph, signature and thumb impression.
  18. Complete live image capture where requested by the portal.
  19. Review the application carefully.
  20. Submit the prescribed declarations.
  21. Pay the applicable application fee through the online gateway.
  22. Verify the successful payment and application submission status.
  23. Download and save the completed application form.

Important: Candidates should complete the entire process before 11 December 2026 at 11:30 PM. Fees paid for additional or duplicate applications are not refundable.

Signature JPG/JPEG 80 KB - 150 KB
Thumb Impression JPG/JPEG 50 KB - 100 KB

The photograph should have a light background. Candidates must sign using black ink on white paper.

Male applicants must upload their left-thumb impression, while female applicants must upload their right-thumb impression.

Documents Required for AFCAT 1 2027

Applicants should keep the following records ready for registration, examination and subsequent AFSB verification:

  • Class 10 certificate for date-of-birth verification.
  • Class 12 certificate and marksheet.
  • Graduation or postgraduate qualification records, where applicable.
  • Engineering degree certificate, where applicable.
  • Recent passport-size photograph.
  • Scanned signature and thumb impression.
  • Aadhaar details.
  • Valid photo identity documents.
  • NCC Air Wing Senior Division 'C' certificate, if applicable.
  • GATE scorecard and engineering records, if applicable.
  • Valid DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence, if claiming the relevant concession.
  • No Objection Certificate for Government/PSU employees, where required.
  • Employer and educational documents required during AFSB testing.
  • Downloaded AFCAT admit card.
  • Other certificates specified by the official notification.

Applicants should use their original academic records while entering details. Eligibility will be verified at subsequent selection stages.

AFCAT 1 2027 Admit Card

The Indian Air Force will make the AFCAT 01/2027 admit card available from 27 January 2027 at 11:00 AM.

Candidates can log in to afcat.edcil.co.in and select the Download Admit Card option.

The admit card will also be communicated electronically through the registered contact details as specified in the notification.

AFCAT 1 2027 Training Details

Training is scheduled to begin in the first week of January 2028.

Branch Approximate Training Duration
Flying Branch 74 Weeks
Ground Duty Technical 74 Weeks
Ground Duty Non-Technical 50 Weeks

Flight Cadets will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 56,100 during training under the notified pay provisions.

AFCAT 1 2027 Important Instructions

  • The recruitment is for AFCAT 01/2027 courses starting in January 2028.
  • The notification lists 284 fixed-number vacancies through AFCAT and GATE Score Entry.
  • NCC Special Entry seats are calculated using the prescribed percentage.

  • Admit cards will be available from 27 January 2027.
  • Flying Branch age eligibility is 20–24 years, subject to CPL relaxation.
  • Ground Duty age eligibility is 20–26 years.
  • Age is calculated as on 1 January 2028.
  • Marital-status conditions must be satisfied when training begins.
  • Branch-specific educational qualifications apply.
  • Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 are mandatory for specified branches.
  • Only candidates completing Class 12 under the 10+2 pattern are eligible.
  • Final-year students may apply subject to the notification's conditions.
  • The AFCAT examination carries 300 marks.
  • One mark is deducted for each incorrect answer.
  • NCC Special Entry candidates are exempt from the AFCAT written examination.
  • GATE Score Entry has separate eligibility requirements.
  • Medical fitness is mandatory for commissioning.
  • Original documents are verified at later stages.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Space Applications Centre (SAC), Ahmedabad, a lead Centre of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Department of Space, has invited online applications for 26 apprentice positions under Advertisement No. SAC: 03:2026: 9 Graduate Apprentice, 5 Technician Apprentice and 12 Trade Apprentice positions. The stipend is ₹12,300, ₹10,900 and ₹10,560 or ₹11,040 a month, for a one-year training. Applications are accepted only on www.sac.gov.in or careers.sac.gov.in from 0930 hours on 11 November 2026 to 1700 hours on 2 December 2026.

SAC Recruitment 2026 Quick Facts

Particulars Details
Establishment Space Applications Centre (SAC), Ahmedabad – 380 015, Indian Space Research Organisation, Department of Space
Advertisement No. SAC: 03:2026 dated 11-11-2026
Trades 26 position codes: 9 Graduate Apprentice, 5 Technician Apprentice, 12 Trade Apprentice

Age Limit Varies by post (see Age section); as on 02-12-2026
Apply At Online only: https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in
Last Date 02-12-2026, 1700 hours

The official notification does not specify the number of seats for each position or any application fee.

About SAC

Space Applications Centre (SAC), Ahmedabad is one of the lead Centres of ISRO, Department of Space, Government of India. The notice says SAC focuses on the design of space borne instruments for terrestrial and planetary missions of ISRO and on the development and operationalization of space technology for national development.

Seats by Trade

The notice lists 26 positions by post code. It does not print the number of seats for any of them.

Who Can Apply

Applications are invited under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time). Only Indian nationals are eligible.

Qualification

Post Codes Qualification Required

07 to 09 (Graduate Apprentice, B.Com, BCA, BA Hindi/English) Graduation in the respective field with minimum 60% marks as declared by Government recognized University / Board / Institute.

15 to 18 (Trade Apprentice) SSC/Matriculation/10th and ITI (NTC/STC) in the relevant trade.
19 to 26 (Trade Apprentice) ITI (NTC/STC) from a recognized institute of Gujarat State.

Graduate and Technician Apprentice applicants must hold the degree or diploma from a Government recognized University/Board/Institute coming under Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Dadra Nagar Haveli & Daman & Diu (UTs). Trade Apprentice applicants must hold ITI (NTC/STC) from a recognized institute of Gujarat State.

The degree, diploma or ITI must have been passed in the relevant field in or after December 2023. The tentative date of joining is January/February 2027. A candidate who passed after December 2023 but completes three years on the expected date of joining is not eligible.

Who Cannot Apply

  • Candidates pursuing higher studies (B.E./B.Tech. in the case of Diploma holders and M.E/M.Tech. in the case of Graduates).

The notice says the stipend is applicable and paid subject to amendment or revision from time to time as per extant orders. The training period is one year, i.e. 12 months starting from the execution of the contract of Apprenticeship. Selected candidates are registered under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and must execute the contract as per that Act and the Amendment Act 1973.

How to Apply for SAC Recruitment 2026

  1. Register the application online only, through the SAC website https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in, between 0930 hours on 11-11-2026 and 1700 hours on 02-12-2026.
  2. Register with a valid e-mail ID. Only one registration is possible with one e-mail ID, and the e-mail ID must be correct because shortlisted candidates are informed only by e-mail.
  3. Fill the fields marked * with correct data and enter the characters shown in the security image. If the image is unclear, click the "Regenerate Image" button.
  4. Enter the marks or result as percentage only. Upload the essential qualification certificates (B.E./B.Tech/Graduate/Diploma/ITI) as .pdf files of maximum 1MB each; the marks, class, month and year of passing must be verifiable from them.
  5. Check all information, then submit. The application can be submitted only once and no correction is possible afterwards.
  6. Note the 14-digit Online Registration Number, used for all future correspondence.
  7. Take a print-out of the application summary before 1700 hours on 02-12-2026; the site will not be open for printing after that time.

Applications submitted without uploading the requisite documents are treated as invalid. Data entered in the online application is considered final.

Selection Process

Candidates are shortlisted or empaneled on the basis of the information furnished in the online application, with due weightage to reservation categories. The result (percentage) of the qualifying exam (Diploma/Degree/I.T.I.) declared by a Government recognized University/Board/Institute is considered to shortlist candidates. Candidates must produce documentary evidence of the marks they enter.

Only shortlisted or empaneled candidates are called for document verification and further process, subject to availability of vacant positions. Intimation is sent only by e-mail. The notice prints no written test and gives no date for document verification.

Documents Required

At document verification, the hard copy of the online application summary must be produced with self-attested copies of the following:

  • Proof of date of birth
  • SSC (10th) and/or HSC (12th) mark sheets and certificate
  • Mark sheets and certificate of the qualifying exam (Degree/Diploma/I.T.I.) declared by a Government recognized University/Board/Institution
  • Latest OBC (NCL) / Caste Certificate / Income and Asset Certificate (EWS) / Tribe certificate / Disability certificate (if applicable)
  • Aadhar Card

Candidates of SC / ST / OBC(NCL) / PwBD / EWS category must hold a valid certificate issued by a competent authority in the prescribed format for recruitment to Central Government posts, for the current financial year. Original documents (including certificates of all educational qualifications) must be produced when asked; failing that, the candidate is considered disqualified.

Important Instructions

  • Any discrepancy in name, age, Diploma/Degree/ITI result and year of passing, or caste/tribe in the online application, at any stage, means disqualification and no claim for apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates who do not meet the prescribed medical fitness criteria at the time of joining have their candidature automatically cancelled.
  • Apprentices have no claim whatsoever for employment in SAC, Ahmedabad or any other Centre/Unit of ISRO/Department of Space after the training period.
  • Candidates shortlisted for document verification are not eligible for Travelling Allowance.
  • Canvassing in any form is a disqualification, and no interim correspondence is entertained.
  • Women candidates are encouraged to apply.
  • General enquiry: 079-26913021/22. Technical queries only: 079-26915510/5513. Timings 1000 to 1700 hours, Monday to Friday.

ASRB Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026: The Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board (ASRB) has released the Centralized Combined Examination 2026 notification dated 11 November 2026 for recruitment to 1,393 Technical Assistant (T-3) and Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) posts in Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) institutes and Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs). ASRB ICAR T-3 and T-4 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification for the chosen functional group/subgroup by 17 December 2026. Although most disciplines require a relevant Bachelor's degree, Annexure-VIII specifically accepts three-year engineering diplomas for certain Workshop Staff groups.

Can Agriculture Graduates Apply for ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant 2026?

Yes. Candidates with a recognized Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or other accepted Agriculture-related disciplines can apply for the relevant Field Farm Technician or Laboratory Technician vacancies.

The Agriculture functional group contains the largest number of vacancies, with 699 T-3 posts and 73 T-4 posts.

Can B.Tech. or Diploma Holders Apply?

Yes. The official qualification schedule permits B.E./B.Tech. and three-year diploma qualifications in specified engineering disciplines for Workshop Staff posts.

However, a diploma is not accepted as a general substitute for the Bachelor's degree required in all other functional groups. Candidates must follow the exact qualification for their chosen discipline.

Can BCA, B.Sc. Computer Science and IT Graduates Apply?

Yes. The Information Technology functional group accepts recognized Bachelor's degrees in Computer Applications, Computer Science or Information Technology, as well as the prescribed B.E./B.Tech. degrees in IT, Computer Science or Electronics and Communication Engineering.

There are 133 T-3 and 48 T-4 vacancies under the Information Technology group.

Can Candidates Apply for More Than One Functional Group?

No. The notification permits selection of only one functional group/subgroup per candidate, even if the candidate possesses qualifications for multiple disciplines.

Within that selected group, the candidate may opt for T-3, T-4 or both, subject to eligibility and vacancy availability. The order of post preferences submitted in the application will be final.

Important: The special in-service employee age provision applies to eligible ICAR employees and does not automatically extend to employees of State Agricultural Universities, State Governments or Public Undertakings.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Salary 2026

The posts carry pay under the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix. T-3 is classified at Pay Level 5 and T-4 at Pay Level 6.

Post Pay Level Pay Scale Initial Basic Pay

Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400 Rs. 35,400

Eligible employees receive applicable Central Government allowances and benefits according to the rules governing ICAR employment and their place of posting.

Salary Clarification: These are notified basic pay scales, not guaranteed monthly in-hand salaries. Allowances and statutory deductions will affect actual take-home pay.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee varies according to the candidate's category and whether the candidate applies for T-3, T-4 or both.

Category T-3 Only T-4 Only Both T-3 and T-4
Unreserved (UR) Rs. 300 Rs. 300 Rs. 600

Payment Portal: Bharatkosh

Payment may be made through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or UPI. Applicable transaction charges are borne by the candidate.

Important: Payment through Bharatkosh alone does not complete the ASRB application. Candidates must upload the payment receipt and successfully submit the application form before the deadline. Fees once paid are non-refundable.

ASRB ICAR T-3 T-4 Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of a qualifying Preliminary CBT and a merit-based Mains CBT, followed by eligibility and document verification by ICAR.

  1. Online application submission.
  2. Combined Preliminary Computer Based Test.
  3. Shortlisting for Mains in a 1:15 ratio against functional-group vacancies, subject to qualifying marks.
  4. Combined Mains Computer Based Test.
  5. Preparation of functional group/subgroup-wise merit lists.
  6. Post allocation according to rank, eligibility, preferences and available vacancies.
  7. Verification of original qualifications and other relevant documents by ICAR.
  8. Appointment subject to applicable conditions and suitability.

No Interview: The notification explicitly confirms that no interview will be conducted. Final selection merit is based on Mains Examination performance only.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Preliminary Exam Pattern 2027

The Preliminary Examination will be conducted online in CBT mode and will contain 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks, with a total duration of one hour.

The Mains Examination will consist of 100 objective questions carrying 300 marks, to be completed in two hours. The paper tests domain-specific knowledge of the selected functional group/subgroup.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Syllabus 2026

ASRB has published separate official syllabus documents for the Preliminary and Mains examinations. Preliminary subjects are common to all candidates, while Mains focuses on the selected domain.

Preliminary Syllabus

  • General Knowledge.
  • General English.
  • Quantitative Aptitude.
  • General Agriculture.

Mains Syllabus

The Mains syllabus is discipline-specific and covers the relevant technical subjects for the chosen functional group, including Agriculture, Animal Science, Fisheries Science, Community Science, Engineering, Library and Information Science, and Information Technology.

ASRB ICAR T-3 T-4 Merit List and Tie-Breaking Rules

The Board prepares merit lists based on Mains marks or applicable normalized scores. If candidates obtain equal Mains marks, the following tie-breaking rules apply in order:

  1. The candidate securing higher marks in the Preliminary CBT receives preference.
  2. If still tied, the candidate securing higher marks in the Quantitative Aptitude section of the Preliminary CBT is ranked higher.
  3. If the tie remains, the older candidate receives preference.

The notification also provides for a reserve panel under specified conditions, including certain vacancies arising from non-joining or departure within one year of joining where a fresh panel is unavailable.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can submit online applications for the Centralized Combined Examination 2026 between 18 November and 17 December 2026.

Official Application Website: www.asrb.gov.in

Application Fee Portal: bharatkosh.gov.in

Last Date: 17 December 2026, 11:59 PM.

How to Apply Online for ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit www.asrb.gov.in.
  2. Open the Centralized Combined Examination 2026 application link for T-3 and T-4 recruitment.
  3. Read the notification and instructions carefully.
  4. Complete the initial One Time Registration (OTR) by entering the required personal and contact details.
  5. Verify the registration details and retain the registration confirmation received by email/SMS.
  6. Complete the remaining sections of the online application form.
  7. Choose only one eligible functional group/subgroup.
  8. Select Technical Assistant T-3, Senior Technical Assistant T-4 or both, depending on eligibility.
  9. Enter post preferences in the required order.
  10. Provide educational qualifications and category information.
  11. Select the prescribed Preliminary and Mains examination centres.
  12. Upload the photograph, signature, identity document and supporting certificates as required.
  13. Check the application details before entering the payment information.
  14. Pay the applicable application fee through Bharatkosh.
  15. Download the Bharatkosh payment receipt.
  16. Upload the fee receipt and enter the required transaction information in the ASRB application form.
  17. Complete final submission.
  18. Verify that the successful submission confirmation appears on the screen.
  19. Save a printout or PDF of the final application.
  20. Complete all steps by 17 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

Important: OTR registration and Bharatkosh fee payment by themselves do not constitute a completed recruitment application. Candidates must finish every application stage and receive successful submission confirmation.

How to Pay ASRB ICAR T-3 T-4 Application Fee Through Bharatkosh?

The notification specifically requires payment using the Government's Bharatkosh portal. Candidates should follow the prescribed purpose and accounting details.

  1. Visit bharatkosh.gov.in.
  2. Click Quick Payment / Non-Registered Users.
  3. Select Individual as depositor category.
  4. Choose Agriculture under Ministry.
  5. Select the prescribed examination/certificate fee purpose for ARS/NET/SMS/STO/FAO/AO.
  6. Verify PAO: 000001 - PAO (Sectt)-I.
  7. Verify DDO: 216968 - Add. ASRB, Chayan Bhavan.
  8. Enter the applicable fee amount according to the selected T-3/T-4 option.
  9. Provide the appropriate payment remarks identifying T-3, T-4 or both.
  10. Enter the captcha and depositor details.
  11. Make payment using the available online method.
  12. Download or print the payment receipt.
  13. Upload the receipt in the ASRB online application.

Payment Caution: Candidates should verify all details directly against Annexure-I before completing payment. An incorrect or incomplete payment submission may prevent successful application processing.

Documents Required for ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following records ready during application and subsequent document verification.

  • Matriculation/Class 10 certificate and marksheet.
  • Relevant Bachelor's degree or qualifying engineering diploma certificates.
  • Semester-wise or final academic marksheets.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph.
  • Scanned signature.
  • Valid photo identity document.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates, where applicable.
  • PwBD certificate, where applicable.
  • Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable.
  • NOC or prescribed undertaking for eligible in-service candidates.
  • Bharatkosh payment receipt for fee-paying candidates.
  • Other documents prescribed in the notification.

The photograph must have a white background, show the face clearly without spectacles, and occupy at least two-thirds of the image. The signature must be made using black or blue ink on white paper.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Application Correction 2026

ASRB has scheduled the application correction window from 18 to 20 December 2026.

However, the notification also restricts changes to submitted application details and makes post preferences final. Candidates should not assume that every field can be changed during the correction period.

Applicants should review all details before final submission, particularly the selected functional group, T-3/T-4 option, post preferences, category and examination centre.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Exam Centres 2027

The Preliminary CBT is planned at 62 tentative examination centres across India, while the Mains CBT has a separate list of 31 centres.

Major Preliminary examination cities include Delhi NCR, Patna, Lucknow, Kanpur, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Mumbai, Pune, Jaipur and other notified locations.

Examination centres may be changed by ASRB depending on administrative requirements. Candidates must choose their preferences carefully because later requests for centre changes will not ordinarily be accepted.

ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Admit Card 2027

The ASRB T-3/T-4 Preliminary CBT admit card is expected to be available approximately one week before the examination on the official ASRB website.

The exact examination and admit card dates will be announced separately.

Candidates must carry the downloaded admission certificate, the original photo ID uploaded during application and two passport-size colour photographs to the examination centre.

  • Application fees must be paid through Bharatkosh.
  • The payment receipt must be uploaded in the ASRB application.
  • The Preliminary CBT carries 100 marks.
  • The Mains CBT carries 300 marks.
  • Negative marking applies in both examinations.
  • Preliminary shortlisting follows a 1:15 vacancy ratio.
  • No interview will be conducted.
  • Final merit is based on Mains performance.
  • Document verification is carried out by the recruiting ICAR organization.
  • Vacancies are tentative and subject to revision.

What Are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions. These commissions recruit candidates for various posts and services under state government departments according to the rules applicable to each recruitment.

State PSC recruitment is not limited to State Civil Services examinations. Public Service Commissions may also recruit candidates for engineering, medical, teaching, agriculture, legal, scientific, technical, administrative and other departmental posts.

The posts available depend on vacancies reported by the respective state government departments and the recruitment notifications issued by the commission.

Popular Posts Recruited Through State PSCs

State Public Service Commissions recruit candidates for a wide range of government posts. Common recruitment categories may include:

  • State Civil Services
  • Administrative Services
  • Assistant Commissioner
  • Assistant Director
  • Assistant Professor
  • Lecturer
  • Medical Officer
  • Veterinary Officer
  • Assistant Engineer
  • Assistant Executive Engineer
  • Agriculture Officer
  • Food Safety Officer
  • Drug Inspector
  • Scientific Officer
  • Law Officer
  • Labour Officer
  • Revenue-related Posts
  • Technical Officers
  • Departmental Officers

The actual posts available vary by commission and recruitment notification.

PSC Jobs by Group (Group 1, 2, 2A, 4 & Others)

Several State Public Service Commissions including TNPSC, APPSC, and TSPSC classify recruitment into numbered "Groups" based on post seniority, pay scale, and administrative responsibility. Understanding these groups helps candidates identify which exam to prepare for based on their qualification and career goals.

Group Typical Posts Minimum Qualification Selection Stages
Group 1 Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains + Interview
Group 2 Assistant Section Officer, Tehsildar, Municipal Commissioner (Grade), Block Development Officer Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains (some states include Interview)
Group 2A Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Field Surveyor Bachelor's degree Written Exam (Certificate Verification)
Group 3 Various department Grade II/Non-Gazetted posts Varies by post Written Exam
Group 4 Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Record Clerk, Village Administrative Officer (VAO) SSLC / 10th or 12th pass (varies by post) Single Written Exam (Certificate Verification)

Group numbering, post names, and minimum qualifications vary by state the table above reflects the common pattern used by TNPSC-style classification. Some states use different group labels or don't use numbered groups at all. Always confirm the exact group structure and eligibility on your state PSC's official notification.

Who Should Apply for Group 4?

Group 4 posts are typically entry-level government jobs open to candidates who have completed SSLC (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th), making them one of the most accessible and high-demand categories of PSC recruitment. These posts don't usually require a specific degree, have a single-stage written exam, and see some of the highest applicant volumes of any PSC exam due to the lower qualification bar and large number of annual vacancies.

State PSC Eligibility Criteria

There is no single eligibility rule for all State PSC jobs. Qualification, age limit, experience and other conditions differ depending on the commission and post.

Eligibility Criteria General Guidance
Educational Qualification Depends on the post and may include Diploma, Graduation, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Post Graduation or another prescribed qualification.
Age Limit Minimum and maximum age limits vary by commission and recruitment.
Age Relaxation Relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the recruitment.
State / Domicile Conditions State-specific eligibility, reservation, language or residency conditions may apply to certain recruitments.
Experience Some technical, teaching, specialist or senior posts require relevant professional experience.
Number of Attempts Attempt restrictions apply only where specifically prescribed for an examination or recruitment.

Important: Candidates should check the detailed recruitment notification before applying because eligibility conditions differ for every State PSC recruitment.

State PSC Selection Process

The State PSC selection process depends on the commission and the type of post. There is no single selection procedure followed for every PSC recruitment.

Depending on the recruitment, the selection process may include one or more of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Written Examination
  • Screening Test
  • Subject-specific Examination
  • Skill Test
  • Physical Test
  • Interview / Personality Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

State Civil Services examinations may have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitment may follow a different selection process.

Always check the individual recruitment notification for the exact examination and selection procedure.

How to Apply for State PSC Jobs 2026

The application process differs slightly between commissions, but candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Find the required State PSC recruitment from the latest jobs table above.
  2. Open the detailed recruitment page.
  3. Check the post name, vacancies, qualification, age limit, application fee and important dates.
  4. Read the official recruitment notification carefully.
  5. Open the official application website or application link.
  6. Complete registration or One-Time Registration if required by the commission.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  9. Pay the application fee if applicable.
  10. Review the application before final submission.
  11. Submit the application before the specified last date.
  12. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates should submit applications only through the application method specified in the official notification.

State PSC Exam Pattern and Syllabus

There is no common exam pattern or syllabus for all State PSC recruitments.

State Civil Services examinations generally cover broader subjects such as General Studies and state-specific topics, while technical, medical, engineering, teaching and departmental recruitment may focus more heavily on subjects related to the post.

The following can differ between recruitments:

  • Number of papers
  • Objective or descriptive examination
  • Total marks
  • Exam duration
  • Negative marking
  • Minimum qualifying marks
  • Language requirements
  • Subject-specific syllabus
  • Interview or skill test requirements

Candidates should refer to the syllabus and exam pattern issued for the specific State PSC recruitment they are applying for.

State PSC Jobs vs UPSC Jobs

State Public Service Commissions and the Union Public Service Commission conduct different recruitment processes.

State PSC UPSC
Conducts recruitment for posts and services connected with the respective state. Conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.
Recruitment rules differ from one State PSC to another. Recruitment is conducted under the rules applicable to UPSC examinations and vacancies.
May recruit for State Civil Services, engineering, medical, teaching, technical and departmental posts. Conducts Civil Services Examination and various other recruitment examinations for Union Government posts.

Candidates looking for Union Government recruitment through UPSC can visit the UPSC Jobs page.

PSC vs PCS - What Is the Difference?

PSC stands for Public Service Commission. It refers to the constitutional commission responsible for conducting recruitment for various government posts and services within its jurisdiction.

PCS commonly refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services posts and examinations.

A State Public Service Commission may conduct a State Civil Services or PCS examination, but it can also conduct recruitment for many other positions such as Medical Officer, Assistant Engineer, Lecturer, Agriculture Officer and departmental posts.

Therefore, State PSC Jobs covers a broader range of recruitment than only PCS or State Civil Services examinations.

How to Choose the Right State PSC Recruitment

Before applying for a State PSC vacancy, candidates should compare the recruitment requirements with their qualification and preferences.

Check the following details:

  • Required educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Category and reservation conditions
  • State or language requirements, if any
  • Number of vacancies
  • Pay scale or salary
  • Job location
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Examination pattern
  • Application deadline

Apply only after confirming that you meet the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

State PSC Recruitment Updates You Should Check

A recruitment notification can sometimes be followed by additional notices from the commission. Candidates should continue checking recruitment updates even after submitting their application.

Important updates may include:

  • Application date extension
  • Correction window
  • Vacancy revision
  • Exam date
  • Exam city information
  • Admit card
  • Answer key
  • Result
  • Interview schedule
  • Document verification schedule
  • Final selection result

Relevant updates should be linked from the individual recruitment page whenever they are released.

What are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC Jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions for various posts and services under state government departments.

Which State PSC jobs are currently open?

Where can I find the latest State PSC recruitment notifications?

You can check the latest State PSC recruitment notifications on this page or select your commission from the State-wise PSC Jobs section to find recruitment specific to your state.

What qualification is required for State PSC jobs?

There is no single qualification required for all State PSC jobs. Depending on the post, candidates may need a Diploma, Graduation, Engineering degree, Medical qualification, Law degree, Post Graduation or another specified qualification.

Are all State PSC jobs for graduates?

No. Eligibility depends on the individual recruitment. Many administrative posts require a degree, while technical, professional and departmental posts may have different qualification requirements.

What is the age limit for State PSC jobs?

The minimum and maximum age limits vary according to the commission and post. Candidates should check the age criteria given in the individual recruitment notification.

Is age relaxation available for State PSC recruitment?

Age relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the respective recruitment. The exact relaxation should be checked in the official notification.

Is domicile compulsory for State PSC jobs?

Not for every State PSC recruitment. Some vacancies may have state-specific residency, reservation, language or other eligibility requirements. Candidates should check the relevant recruitment rules before applying.

What is the selection process for State PSC jobs?

The selection process varies by post. It may include a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, written test, screening test, skill test, interview, physical test, document verification or medical examination.

Do all State PSC recruitments have Prelims and Mains?

No. Prelims and Mains are common in some State Civil Services examinations, but many technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitments follow a different examination or selection process.

How can I apply for State PSC recruitment?

Open the required recruitment from the latest jobs table, read the eligibility and application details, check the official notification and use the official application link provided on the recruitment page.

What is the difference between State PSC and UPSC?

State PSCs conduct recruitment mainly for posts and services connected with their respective states, while UPSC conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.

Is PSC the same as PCS?

No. PSC means Public Service Commission, while PCS generally refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services. A State PSC can recruit for PCS as well as many other administrative, technical, medical and departmental posts.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 FAQs

What is the last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

There is no common last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026. Each state or district publishes its own closing date. Check the live recruitment table for the applicable notification.

Where can I apply for Anganwadi jobs online in 2026?

Apply through the official state or district recruitment portal mentioned in the specific advertisement. Some Anganwadi recruitments require offline applications instead.

Is Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026 available?

Supervisor vacancies are announced separately by the relevant recruitment authorities. Candidates should confirm an active Supervisor notification before applying.

What is the last date for Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026?

The last date depends on the state and the Supervisor advertisement. Worker and Helper application deadlines do not automatically apply to Supervisor posts.

Can 10th or 12th pass candidates apply for Anganwadi jobs?

Yes, some Anganwadi Worker and Helper notifications accept Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications. The required qualification depends on the post and recruiting authority.

Is there an examination for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

The selection method depends on the official notification. Candidates should check whether the recruitment involves academic merit, a written examination, interview or other prescribed stages.

How can I find Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 in Haryana or Telangana?

Check the state-wise recruitment section and open the relevant district notification. Verify the post, vacancy, deadline and application mode before applying.

Where can I find Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 in Maharashtra?

Check the relevant Maharashtra Women and Child Development or district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Sevika, Helper and Supervisor vacancies, as applicable.

Is wcd.gov.in the Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 official website?

The central Ministry of Women and Child Development website is wcd.gov.in. Recruitment application portals differ by state and district, so applicants must use the portal specified in their notification.

Can I apply for an Anganwadi vacancy in another district?

That depends on the recruitment's residence and eligibility rules. Some Worker and Helper notices require candidates to belong to a particular village, ward or project area.

Forest Guard recruitment is suitable for candidates interested in forest protection, patrolling and field-level government work. Forest Guard vacancies are generally announced by state forest departments or authorized recruitment boards.

What does a Forest Guard do?

A Forest Guard helps protect forest areas, monitor activities, assist with wildlife conservation and report suspected forest offences. Duties can include patrolling assigned forest areas and supporting senior forest officials.

What is the qualification for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Some Forest Guard recruitments require Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications from a recognized board. However, the exact educational requirements depend on the state and recruitment notification.

Candidates should check:

  • Education: Required qualification and recognized board.

  • Selection Process: Written examination, physical tests or other notified stages.
  • Vacancies: Total and category-wise posts.
  • Application Dates: Registration opening and closing dates.

How can I apply for Forest Guard Vacancy 2026?

Find the Forest Guard recruitment in the vacancy table above, open the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and follow the official application instructions.

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 - RFO Jobs

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 provides opportunities for candidates interested in forest administration, conservation and supervisory roles.

A Forest Range Officer, also referred to as a Range Forest Officer or RFO in some recruitment systems, may oversee forest protection activities, supervise field staff and manage responsibilities within an assigned forest range.

What is the qualification for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Forest Range Officer recruitment generally involves graduate-level eligibility. Some notifications require degrees in specified subjects such as science, agriculture, forestry or other approved disciplines.

The accepted qualifications vary by recruiting organization. A graduation degree alone does not automatically make a candidate eligible for every RFO vacancy.

How are Forest Range Officers selected?

Depending on the recruitment rules, selection may include:

  • Preliminary or main written examinations
  • Physical standards or fitness assessments
  • Interviews, where prescribed
  • Document verification
  • Medical examination

Candidates searching for RFO Vacancy 2026, Forest Ranger Recruitment or Forest Range Service Officer notifications should check the relevant vacancy details for exact eligibility and selection stages.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Frequently Asked Questions

1. Is Forest Department Recruitment 2026 open?

Forest-related vacancies are announced throughout the year by different recruiting organizations. Check the latest vacancy table above for the status of individual recruitments. An advertised post should be considered open only within its confirmed application period.

2. What is the last date for Forest Department Recruitment 2026?

The last date differs for each recruitment. Check the applicable notification's closing date in the table and verify it against the official announcement.

3. How can I apply for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Find an applicable Forest Guard vacancy, review the educational and physical requirements, and follow the official application instructions before the closing date.

4. Can 10th-pass candidates apply for Forest Department jobs?

Some Forest Guard, Forest Watcher and support recruitments may accept Class 10 qualifications. Eligibility depends on the post and recruiting authority.

5. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for Forest Guard vacancies?

Yes, some Forest Guard recruitments accept Class 12 qualifications. Check the specific notification to confirm any subject or additional eligibility requirements.

6. Can graduates apply for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Graduates may qualify for certain Forest Range Officer vacancies, but some recruitments require degrees in specified disciplines. Candidates must verify the accepted qualifications.

7. Is a physical test required for Forest Guard recruitment?

Many Forest Guard recruitments include physical standards or fitness tests. The exact requirements depend on the recruiting authority.

8. What is the age limit for Forest Guard recruitment?

The age limit varies by state and notification. Check the official minimum and maximum ages, cut-off date and applicable relaxations.

9. Is there an exam for Forest Department jobs?

Many Forest Guard, Forester and officer-level recruitments include written examinations. Other roles may use different selection methods. Follow the official selection process for the chosen vacancy.

10. What is the difference between a Forest Guard and a Forest Range Officer?

A Forest Guard generally performs field-level protection and monitoring duties. A Forest Range Officer usually carries supervisory and administrative responsibilities for a forest range. Exact duties differ under the relevant service rules.

11. Can ex-servicemen apply for Forest Department recruitment?

Eligible ex-servicemen can apply for vacancies where they meet the recruitment requirements. Reservation benefits and relaxations depend on the applicable rules.

12. Are Forest Department jobs available in every state?

Different states announce vacancies at different times. Not every state or post necessarily has an active recruitment notification at any given moment.

13. Is there a single apply online link for all Forest Department vacancies?

No. Each recruiting organization may use a different application portal or offline application process.

14. Where can I download the official Forest Department notification PDF?

Open the relevant recruitment from the latest vacancy table and follow its official notification link.

Note: Apprenticeship posts (under the Apprentices Act) are not regular government jobs but are a popular no-exam entry route into PSUs and railways for ITI/diploma/graduate candidates, offering valuable hands-on experience.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.
