Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 Download Link

Candidates can check their SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam City 2026 through the official Staff Selection Commission candidate login portal. The exam city intimation facility provides advance information about the allotted examination city and scheduled examination date.

Candidates should log in using their SSC Registration Number and Password to check the examination city information. The city slip is not a substitute for the admit card, which will be issued separately.

SSC CPO Exam City Link: Check Exam City Intimation Slip 2026

How to Download SSC CPO Exam City Slip 2026?

Candidates can check their SSC CPO examination city by following these steps.

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the Login or Register option.
  3. Enter your Registration Number and Password.
  4. Log in to the SSC candidate dashboard.
  5. Find the SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam City Intimation 2026 option.
  6. Click on the examination city details link when available.
  7. Check the allotted examination city, date and shift information.
  8. Download or save the displayed details for future reference.

SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam Date 2026

The Staff Selection Commission will conduct the SSC CPO Paper 1 examination from 23 November to 28 November 2026. The examination will be held in CBT mode at designated examination centres.

Candidates should check their allotted exam date and city through the official candidate portal. The complete examination centre address and reporting instructions will be provided on the admit card.

SSC CPO Admit Card 2026

The SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 is expected to become available from 20 November 2026 onwards. Candidates will need to download the admit card separately before appearing for the examination.

The admit card will contain the examination centre address, exam date, reporting time and important examination instructions.

  • Allotted examination city

  • Additional candidate instructions

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), in Advertisement No. 13/2026, invites online applications for 13 vacancies in four posts: Dental Surgeon (5, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare), Ayurveda Physician (2) and Homeopathic Physician (1) (both New Delhi Municipal Council), and Scientist 'B' (5, Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change). All four posts are at Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Candidates are shortlisted for interview, with a Recruitment Test if held. Applications are taken on upsconline.nic.in from 14 November 2026 until 1800 hrs on 04 December 2026, and eligibility is fixed on that closing date.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

This is a recruitment by selection to four Group A Gazetted, Non-Ministerial posts under the Central Government and the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post was advertised earlier and is re-advertised with changed PwBD suitability.

Advertisement No. 13/2026

Total Vacancies 13
Departments Department of Health & Family Welfare; New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC); Botanical Survey of India
Qualification Varies by post: BDS, Ayurveda degree, Homoeopathy degree or Master's Degree in Botany/Horticulture/Chemistry (Organic)
Age Limit Varies by post
Pay Level or Pay Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (plus NPA for Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician)
Application Fee Rs. 25/- (no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women)

Application Dates 14-11-2026 to 04-12-2026 (1800 hrs)

Job Location Anywhere in India (Dental Surgeon); New Delhi (NDMC posts); Kolkata (Scientist 'B')
Official Website https://upsconline.nic.in

The official notification does not specify the Recruitment Test pattern or the interview date.

About UPSC Recruitment 2026

The Union Public Service Commission invites these applications through its online recruitment application portal. The Dental Surgeon post serves in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh. The Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts are in the AYUSH Cadre of the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post is at the Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, Salt Lake City, Kolkata.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement published / online applications start 14-11-2026
Last date for online applications 04-12-2026, 1800 hrs
Date for age and similar eligibility conditions, Scientist 'B' only (original closing date) 03-07-2026
Interview date To be intimated separately

Applications start on 14 November 2026. The date for determining the eligibility of all candidates in every respect is the closing date for online applications. For Scientist 'B', the notice says the original closing date, 03.07.2026, prevails for age and similar eligibility conditions.

UPSC Vacancy 2026

The notice carries 13 vacancies in total: 5 + 2 + 1 + 5.

Post Vacancy No. Organisation Pay Level Vacancies
Dental Surgeon 26111301114 Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare Level 10 5
Ayurveda Physician 26111302114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 2
Homeopathic Physician 26111303114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 1
Scientist 'B' 26111304214 Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change Level 10 5
Total 13

UPSC Category-wise Vacancy 2026

Post UR EWS OBC SC Total
Dental Surgeon 3 1 - 1 5
Ayurveda Physician 1 1 - - 2
Homeopathic Physician - 1 - - 1

Of the five Dental Surgeon vacancies, one is reserved for persons with benchmark disability (PwBD) in the Deaf and Hard of Hearing category. Ayurveda Physician, Homeopathic Physician and Scientist 'B' are not reserved for PwBD but are identified as suitable for certain disability types. The disability-type suitability tables for each post are in the official notification.

The five Scientist 'B' vacancies may be filled by candidates with these disciplines: MSc Botany - 3; MSc Horticulture - 1; MSc Chemistry (Organic) - 1.

UPSC Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Qualification Required
Dental Surgeon A recognised Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree included in part-1 of the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948), or one of the alternatives listed below; registration with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India; completion of CRI.
Ayurveda Physician Degree in Ayurveda of a recognized University/Statutory State Board/Council/Faculty of Indian Systems of Medicine recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act 1970 (48 of 1970); enrolment on the Centre or a State Register for Indian Medicine.
Homeopathic Physician Degree in Homoeopathy of a Recognised University/Statutory State Board/Council or equivalent recognised under the Homoeopathic Central Council Act, 1973 (59 of 1973); enrolment on the Central Register of Homoeopathy or State Register of Homoeopathy.
Scientist 'B' Master's Degree in Botany or Horticulture or Chemistry (Organic) from a recognised University or Institute. Desirable: Doctorate in the same subjects.

Dental Surgeon: alternative qualifications

  • A recognised Dental qualification obtained upto 01.11.1972 under Part-II of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • OR a recognised Dental qualification granted by an authority or institution outside India, only when granted to a citizen of India upto 13.08.2009 under Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948.
  • OR a citizen of India with a foreign qualification who has appeared and passed the Screening Test Examination as per Screening Test Regulation 2009 w.e.f. 13.08.2009.
  • Candidates who have not completed CRI (compulsory rotating internship) may appear for selection, but if selected must complete it satisfactorily before appointment.

Other conditions

  • Citizenship: a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from the countries named in the notice. The last three groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.
  • Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC, for reasons to be recorded in writing, for candidates otherwise well qualified.
  • Where enough eligible PwBD candidates are not available for posts reserved or identified suitable for them, the experience qualification may be relaxed up to 50 per cent. The notice prints no experience requirement for these four posts.
  • Candidature at all stages is provisional, subject to satisfying the eligibility conditions.

Candidates should read the official notification for the disability-specific suitability of each post.

UPSC Age Limit 2026

The age limit differs by post. The age limit shown is the normal limit for EWS/UR candidates and the relaxed limit for SC/OBC candidates where printed. The age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. The notice sets the closing date for online applications as the date for determining eligibility; for Scientist 'B' age and similar conditions, the original closing date 03.07.2026 prevails.

Post Age Limit
Dental Surgeon 35 years for UR, 35 years for EWS, and 40 years for SC
Ayurveda Physician 35 years for UR and 35 years for EWS
Homeopathic Physician 35 years for EWS
Scientist 'B' 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC

Category Relaxation
SC/ST/OBC/PwBD (vacancies reserved for them) Up to five years for SC/ST, up to three years for OBC, up to ten years for PwBD
PwBD 10 years in the upper age limit for posts identified suitable for the disability (SC/ST get maximum 15 years including 5 years for their category; OBC maximum up to 13 years); applicant's maximum age on the closing date must not exceed 56 years; minimum 40% disability
Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers including ECOs/SSCOs Five years, if continuous service in the Armed Forces on the closing date is not less than six months after attestation (ECO/SSCO conditions apply as printed)
Central/UT Government servants Up to 5 years (10 years for SC/ST and 8 years for OBC in respect of posts reserved for them), with 3 years continuous service in Central Government in the same line or an allied cadre; decision rests with the Commission

UPSC Salary 2026

Post Pay Level Pay Scale
Dental Surgeon Level 10 Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Ayurveda Physician Level 10 plus NPA Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Homeopathic Physician Level 10 plus NPA Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Scientist 'B' Level 10 Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC

For the Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts, private practice of any kind is prohibited, for which non-practicing allowance (NPA) is allowed. The notice prints no rupee amount.

UPSC Application Fee 2026

Category Fee
Candidates other than Female/SC/ST/PwBD (OBC, EWS and Unreserved male candidates pay the full fee) Rs. 25/- (Rupees Twenty five)
SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates of any community No fee

The fee is paid by Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment or by internet banking of any Bank, and the payment mode must be opted for up to the closing date/time. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected, and no representation is entertained. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance and cannot be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

UPSC Selection Process 2026

Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of the information in their online applications and their performance in the Recruitment Test (RT), if held. The stages in order are:

  1. Shortlisting based on the online application, with a Recruitment Test if held.
  2. Interview.
  • If applications are large, the Commission may restrict the number called for interview by desirable qualification, higher qualification, higher experience, counting experience before or after the essential qualification, invoking experience even where none is prescribed, or by holding a Recruitment Test.
  • Minimum suitability in the interview, out of 100 marks: UR-50, OBC-45, SC/ST/PH-40.
  • Where an RT is followed by an interview, a candidate must reach the minimum suitability for the category at both stages. The RT minimum is decided by the Commission case to case.
  • The date of the interview, for which shortlisted candidates bring the print-out of the online application and other documents, will be intimated separately.
  • If a Recruitment Test forms part of selection, it will ordinarily be held at Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi and Visakhapatnam. The list is subject to change.

UPSC Job Description 2026

Dental Surgeon

  • Looks after OPD and indoor patients in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh.
  • Medical attendance with treatment of Central Government employees, members of their families, Central Government Pensioners and other beneficiaries covered by the Central Government Health Scheme.
  • Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

Ayurveda Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Ayurveda Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Homeopathic Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Homoeopathy Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Scientist 'B'

  • To undertake research on floristic / taxonomic revisions.
  • To identify plants.
  • To prepare proper scientific reports on field or herbarium specimens.
  • To undertake field excursions.
  • To supervise the work of Scientific Asstt. & Technical Asstt.

How to Apply Online for UPSC Recruitment 2026

  1. Go to the Commission's website https://upsconline.nic.in and read the General instructions, Profile/Module-wise instructions and instructions for uploading documents on the menu bar of the home page.
  2. Register on the portal to get a Universal Registration Number (URN), giving the details of one Photo ID Card (Aadhaar is strongly advised) in the URN profile.
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF), uploading a photograph and capturing a live photograph, and uploading three signatures made one below the other in black ink on plain white paper.
  4. Fill the post/vacancy-specific module for the advertised post and upload, in pdf, the documents supporting each claim (date of birth, category, disability, qualification, experience, age relaxation).

  6. Submit the application by 1800 hrs on 04-12-2026 and take a print-out of the finally submitted application. An Application Number is generated; keep it with the URN for communication.
  • Failure to provide the required information/documents along with the CAF cancels candidature for the post.
  • Candidates are not required to send printouts or documents by post or by hand. They bring them if called for interview.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the closing date.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth.
  • Degree/Diploma certificate; if unavailable, a provisional certificate with mark sheets for all academic years.
  • Order/letter on equivalent qualification, if one is claimed as equivalent.
  • Experience certificate in the prescribed proforma from the Head of Organisation, where claimed. Pay slips, resumes, appointment letters, relieving letters and unsigned experience certificates must not be uploaded in the Document Upload Module.
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma for SC/ST/OBC; OBC candidates also a declaration of non-creamy layer status.
  • Certificate of Disability in the prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates.
  • Age relaxation certificates for Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers, or Central/UT Government employees (issued after the date of advertisement).
  • Name-change documents, if the name has changed after matriculation.
  • Certificates for professional registration, language, publications, NET, GATE, conference and internship claims, where made.

Documents in a language other than Hindi or English need a transcript attested by a Gazetted officer or notary.

CSIR - National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi (under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research) invites applications from Indian citizens for 25 Multi Tasking Staff posts under Advertisement No. Rectt./05/2026. The prescribed form, downloaded from www.nplindia.in, goes by post to the Senior Controller of Administration, CSIR- National Physical Laboratory, Dr. K.S. Krishnan Marg, New Delhi-110012, and must reach on or before 23 December 2026. Late receipt is not entertained.

CSIR-NPL MULTI TASKING STAFF at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationCSIR - National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi
Advertisement No.Rectt./05/2026
Post(s)Multi Tasking Staff (Post Code MTS)

Job LocationCSIR-NPL, New Delhi

About CSIR-NPL

CSIR-National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi, is described in the notice as a premier laboratory under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research and as the National Metrology Institute (NMI) of India, created by an act of parliament. It has six scientific and technical divisions, among them the Physico-Mechanical Metrology Division and the Indian Standard Time Division. Its research groups work on areas such as quantum metrology, nano science, thin films, cryogenics and instrumentation.

Where and How to Send

Download the prescribed application form from the NPL website www.nplindia.in. Complete it and send it by post in an envelope superscribed “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MTS” to: Senior Controller of Administration, CSIR- National Physical Laboratory, Dr. K.S. Krishnan Marg, New Delhi-110012. The application must reach on or before 23 December 2026, and the same date applies to candidates from far-flung areas. Applications arriving after the closing date for any reason, such as wrongly addressed envelopes, delivery elsewhere or postal delay, are not entertained.

The application fee is Rs. 500/- (“if applicable”), paid by crossed Demand Draft or Pay Order drawn on any nationalized bank, valid for at least 3 months, in favour of “Director, National Physical Laboratory”, payable at New Delhi. Write the candidate’s name and the post code applied for (MTS) on the back of the Demand Draft. Candidates belonging to the SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Abroad/Transgender categories are exempted from the application fee. SC/ST candidates applying against unreserved posts also get the fee exemption. The fee is not refunded and cannot be held for any other recruitment.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The notice announces 25 Multi Tasking Staff posts. The category break-up is printed as follows, and the vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease at the time of final selection.

CategoryPosts
UR12
EWS3
OBC (NCL)6
ST4
Total25

Of the 25 posts, 1 post is reserved for PwBD category [b] and 1 post for PwBD category [c]. In addition, 3 posts are reserved for Ex-serviceman. The notice prints no vacancies for SC.

  • Qualification: essential is Matriculation or equivalent pass; desirable is Intermediate (12th Class) pass. Results must be declared on or before the last date of application, and the qualification must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by Govt. of India or approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies.
  • Age: not less than 18 years and not exceeding 25 years, counted as on 23.12.2026.
  • Pay: Level 1 (Rs.18,000-56,900), basic pay Rs.18,000/-, total emoluments Rs. 41040/- per month. Total emoluments are approximate, on the minimum of the scale, including House Rent Allowance in a Class ‘X’ city.
  • Nationality: the applicant must be a citizen of India.

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST: 5 years and OBC (NCL): 3 years, only where the posts are reserved for these categories. SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age relaxation.
  • PwBD: 10 years for Unreserved candidates (15 years in total for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC), with a disability of not less than 40%, provided the post is identified suitable for the relevant category of disability.
  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years, after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age on the last date of application.
  • The notice adds that other relaxations apply as per extant GoI/CSIR rules and that the listed relaxations are not exhaustive.

Allowances and Service Terms

The posts carry Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance and Transport Allowance as admissible to central government employees and applicable to CSIR. HRA is not admissible if Council or Government accommodation is used. New entrants are governed by the National Pension System or the extant pension system. Medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession and House Building Advance are admissible as per CSIR rules. Selected candidates are on probation for two years from taking over charge; the period may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Competent Authority, and confirmation follows as per extant rules. They may be transferred to any CSIR Lab or Institute anywhere in India and cannot apply for appointment elsewhere or in the Laboratory during probation.

CSIR-NPL MULTI TASKING STAFF Job Description

The notice lists the job requirements and nature of the job as:

  • Physical maintenance of records of the Section; general cleanliness and upkeep of the Section; carrying files and documents to other Sections.
  • Photocopying, sending FAX, etc.; delivering the Dak; opening and closing the Section; assisting in Research & Development activities.
  • Guest House work: maintenance of records, collection and remittance of Guest House charges, cleanliness and maintenance of rooms, attending to guests’ complaints, queries and requirements, dusting of furniture, and preparation and supply of Tea/Coffee to the guests.
  • Maintenance and upkeep of gardens and green spaces: planting, nurturing and caring for plants, mowing lawns, trimming hedges, weeding, clearing debris, watering, fertilizing and pest control.
  • Physical maintenance of records of the work area and stock entry.
  • Vehicle work: maintenance and upkeep of vehicles, scheduling maintenance and repairs, managing vehicle records and log books, allocation of duties, liaising with the office for vehicle bills, and processing Fast-tag and insurance renewal bills.
  • Performing driver duties if required, in which case the incumbent is eligible for honorarium as per Rules. If required, the incumbent may have to work shift duties, and any other work assigned by the Competent Authority.

Enclosures

The notice lists these documents to attach to the application form sent by post:

  • Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- as application fee wherever applicable, with name and post on the back.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph pasted on Part I of the form and signed across in full.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph pasted on Part II of the form, not signed across the photograph.
  • Self-attested photocopy of the Date of Birth certificate (SSC/Matriculation/10th/SSLC/HSC certificate or a Birth certificate issued by the appropriate government authority is accepted as age proof).
  • Self-attested photocopy of educational certificate(s) and/or mark sheet(s) supporting the essential qualification and any higher qualification; where CGPA/SGPA grades are awarded, a copy of the board’s conversion formula into percentage.
  • Self-attested photocopy of caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), if applicable; OBC (NCL) candidates must also furnish the Form of Declaration.
  • Self-attested photocopies of experience certificates, if any.
  • Self-attested photocopy of EWS / PwBD / Women seeking relaxation / Ex-Serviceman / Transgender certificate, if applicable, and other relevant documents, if any.

Selection Process

Selection has three steps: scrutiny of applications, a written examination and a final merit list.

Screening of Applications

A duly constituted Screening Committee scrutinises the applications, adopts its own criteria and shortlists candidates to be called for the written examination. Possessing the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called. Screening is prima facie, based on the documents and information furnished.

Written Examination

The competitive written examination is one paper with four subjects, OMR-based objective type multiple choice, at Class 10 standard. Questions are set in English and Hindi, except the questions on the English Language. The paper has 150 questions to be answered in 2 hours.

PartSubjectQuestionsMarks
One paperGeneral Intelligence2575 (three marks per correct answer)
One paperQuantitative Aptitude2575 (three marks per correct answer)
One paperGeneral Awareness50150 (three marks per correct answer)
One paperEnglish Language50150 (three marks per correct answer)

There is one negative mark for every wrong answer. The minimum threshold (cut-off) marks for each category will be notified on the CSIR-NPL website before the written examination. The notice prints no examination date.

Merit List and Tie Rules

The final merit list is prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination. If two or more candidates have equal aggregate marks, the order of preference is: lesser negative marks; older date of birth; earlier acquisition of the essential qualification; alphabetical order of first names.

Important Instructions

  • Applicants working in CSIR, Government Departments, Autonomous bodies, Universities, PSUs or Government Funded Research Agencies must apply through proper channel; otherwise candidature will not be considered. Their hard copy must reach on or before 23.12.2026.
  • Employees of Government Departments need an employer endorsement that they will be relieved within one month of receipt of the appointment orders, with vigilance clearance recorded. An advance copy may be submitted before the closing date.
  • Name, date of birth and parents’ names must be filled strictly as in the SSC/Matriculation/10th Standard/SSLC/HSC certificate. A change of name needs a Gazette Notification or affidavit.
  • Candidates must state whether any blood or close relative works in CSIR-NPL, CSIR or any other CSIR national lab, institute or unit.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) certificates must be in the prescribed format issued by the Competent Authority; OBC (NCL) candidates need a certificate under Government of India criteria. EWS claims need an Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format.
  • Documents in a language other than Hindi or English need a transcript attested by a Gazetted Officer or notary.
  • Incomplete applications (without photograph, application fee, testimonials or signature) are summarily rejected, and false or incorrect information can lead to cancellation, or removal from service after joining.
  • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. No interim enquiry or correspondence is entertained.
  • Updates, including shortlisted candidates for the written examination, will be displayed only on https://www.nplindia.in. The Director may cancel the advertisement or not fill the posts.
  • If the Hindi and English advertisements differ, the English advertisement is final.

WAPCOS Limited, a Government of India Undertaking, has released a notice to engage Experts on a project-term basis. WAPCOS describes itself as an ISO 9001:2015, "Mini Ratna-I" organization. The engagement is for work relating to various Power Transmission, Distribution and Solar Projects in India and abroad.

The notice lists 9 posts for Indian Projects and 17 posts for Overseas Projects (Africa Region), which is 26 posts in total. Interested candidates have to send their CV to [email protected] on or before 25.11.2026 (Extended).

Quick Summary

  • Who is recruiting? WAPCOS Limited (A Government of India Undertaking).
  • Which posts? Transmission Expert, Civil Expert, Procurement & Contract Expert, Project Manager, Solar Power Plant Expert, Project Accountant, Office Assistant and other posts listed below.
  • How many vacancies? 11 for Indian Projects and 18 for Overseas Projects (Africa Region), 29 in total as per the vacancies listed against each post. The notice also states that the number of posts is variable and will be decided as per project requirements.
  • Who can apply? Candidates meeting the post-wise qualification and experience conditions, with a maximum age of 67 years as on 01.10.2026.
  • Application start date: Not specified in the notification. The notice is dated 23.10.2026.
  • Last date: 25.11.2026 (Extended).
  • Application mode: Send CV by email to [email protected], using the WAPCOS format.
  • Job location: Place of posting will be finalized at the time of engagement. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India or abroad.

WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 Qualification and Experience

The qualification and experience conditions are given below as stated in the notification, post by post.

Indian Projects

1. Transmission Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • Transmission Line Engineer shall have a professional work record of not less than 10 years in planning, designing, managing, quality assurance and supervising transmission line with voltage levels of minimum 220kV. Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years.
  • Shall have experience of not less than 10 years in survey of transmission line at voltage level of minimum 220kV. Experience of Stringing of conductor, erection of special and multi circuit tower and pile foundation in river crossing will be preferred.

2. Civil Expert (Transmission & Substation) (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor or higher degree in civil engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • The engineer should preferably have minimum 10 years of relevant experience in designing, quality monitoring and supervising of transmission line and Substations civil foundation works with voltage levels covering 132kV and upward up to 220kV. Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years.
  • The expert shall have an understanding of High Voltage Transmission line clearances and safety considerations and knowledge on AutoCAD or similar software.
  • Should be well conversant with methods and tools involved in the construction or repair of buildings or other structures and specially the different types of foundation involves in transmission lines including pile and well foundation.

3. Procurement & Contract Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Post graduate degree in Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • The Procurement and Contract Expert shall have an professional work record of not less than 10 years in managing procurement and contract management for works of construction of transmission lines and substations of voltage level upto 220kV.
  • Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years for any Externally Aided Project.
  • Expert should be well conversant with the procurement guidelines and procedures of the externally aided project. Expert having certification from MDBs, will be preferable.

4. Sr. Environmental Safeguard Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Master's degree in Environmental Science/Environmental Management/Environmental Engineering or in similar field from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • 10 years of demonstrated experience in preparation and implementation of EIA/ESIAs and EMP/ESMPs for assessment, management and monitoring environmental and social risks and impacts in linear Infrastructure projects. The expert should be conversant with the Environmental Codes of Practice in the context of Govt. of India. The expert should also be conversant with the environmental and social policies of Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs).
  • Experience in overseeing Energy Infrastructure projects will be an added advantage.
  • Must have experience of working in at least two Externally Aided Projects for overall period of minimum 5 years.
  • Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 5 years.

5. Sr. Social Safeguard Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Master's degree in Social Science / Social Work / Social Management or similar field from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • 10 years of demonstrated experience in preparation and implementation of social assessments and management plans, resettlement action plan/Tribal Development Plan, Livelihood assessment and restoration plan etc. in linear Infrastructure projects. The expert should also be conversant with the social policies of Govt. of India and Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs).
  • Experience in overseeing Energy Infrastructure projects will be an added advantage.
  • Must have experience of working in at least two Externally Aided Projects for overall period of minimum 5 years.
  • Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 5 years.

6. Occupational, Health & Safety Officer (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Degree / P.G. Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety/ Industrial safety or equivalent from any recognized Institution.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Occupational, Health and Safety management. The officer should be well conversant with the safety policies and regulations adopted by the MDB funded linear infrastructure projects and should have minimum 3 years' experience.
  • Moreover, the expert having experience of working under PMC services/consultant will be an added advantage.

7. Environmental Investigation Officer (3 vacancies)

Qualification: M.Sc. in Environmental Science or in relevant field from recognized institution.

Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience of working on environment related aspects of transmission line and substation construction projects of 132kV/220kV level. The experience in projects funded by Multilateral Development Banks shall be preferred.

8. Project Accountant (1 vacancy)

Qualification: B.Com. from recognized institution.

Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in accounting of power transmission and distribution sector infrastructure development projects. The experience in projects funded by Multilateral Development Banks shall be preferred.

9. Office Assistant (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Any Graduate Degree from recognized institution.

Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in assisting office works related to power transmission and distribution sector infrastructure development projects.

  • The Distribution Line Engineer shall have worked on at least two (2) projects of similar nature and scope within the last seven (7) years, including large-scale roll-out of electricity connections.

  • Must have achieved at least over the last seven (07) years following tasks:

The consultancy remuneration may be reviewed after one year based on performance and the applicable engagement conditions. The advertisement does not provide regular employee benefits such as Dearness Allowance, accommodation or medical reimbursement. Official travel allowances may be permitted under the prescribed conditions.

AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

AAI will select eligible candidates through document verification and interview. According to the official notification, candidates must secure a minimum of 50 marks in the interview for selection based on merit ranking.

  1. Document Verification: Verification of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other prescribed documents.
  2. Interview: Assessment of eligible candidates based on the requirements of the relevant consultant position.
  3. Merit-Based Selection: Selection based on interview merit ranking, subject to the prescribed minimum of 50 marks.

The document verification and interview schedule will be communicated later by AAI.

AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Contract Period

The initial consultant engagement will be for one year. The contract may be extended for another year at a time, subject to the applicable conditions, with a maximum cumulative engagement period of five years.

The assignment is full-time, and selected consultants cannot undertake another assignment during their consultancy period. They will be engaged as independent consultants rather than regular AAI employees.

  1. Visit the official Airports Authority of India website at www.aai.aero.
  2. Open the Careers or Recruitment section.
  3. Find Advertisement No. 01/HR/2026/RHQ-SR for the engagement of consultants in the Southern Region.
  4. Read the original notification and Corrigendum-01 carefully.
  5. Open the online registration link for the consultant recruitment.
  6. Enter the required personal, educational and professional experience details.
  7. Upload the necessary documents in the prescribed formats.
  8. Review the completed application and submit it online before 25 November 2026.
  9. Retain a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

J&K Bank Recruitment 2026: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Limited has released two detailed recruitment notifications for 1,053 Banking Associate and Probationary Officer vacancies. These include 1,033 Banking Associate posts for domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and 20 Probationary Officer posts for domiciles of the Union Territory of Ladakh. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university can apply, subject to the respective domicile and age requirements. The basic age limit is 20 to 30 years as on 1 January 2026, with category-specific relaxation and an additional special age concession for the Ladakh PO recruitment. Online applications are accepted from 7 November to 26 November 2026 through the Careers section of jkb.bank.in.

The JK Bank Banking Associate Recruitment 2026 selection is based on a single online examination conducted by IBPS, while JK Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026 requires a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Interview. The starting basic pay is Rs. 24,050 for Banking Associates and Rs. 48,480 for Probationary Officers. Candidates must read the respective notification carefully, as J&K domicile holders are eligible for the Banking Associate recruitment and Ladakh domicile holders are eligible for the Probationary Officer recruitment covered by these advertisements.

Only candidates holding the required Ladakh domicile are eligible for the Probationary Officer recruitment in the uploaded notification.

Reservation will be implemented according to the applicable rules of the respective Union Territory. The notifications provide reservation percentages but do not publish a complete category-wise allocation of the 1,033 and 20 vacancies.

J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Both posts require a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a university recognized by the Government of India or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government or UGC.

Probationary Officer Graduation in Any Discipline

Candidates must possess a valid graduation marksheet or degree certificate by 26 November 2026, the last date of online registration.

Applicants must enter their graduation marks percentage while applying. Candidates whose universities award CGPA or OGPA must convert their grades into percentages according to the university's official conversion formula and provide documentary proof when required.

Can Final-Year Students Apply for J&K Bank Recruitment 2026?

Final-year students who have not completed their graduation by 26 November 2026 do not satisfy the prescribed qualification cut-off. Candidates must have documentary proof that they are graduates by the registration closing date.

Is a Domicile Certificate Mandatory?

Yes. The recruitment is restricted to candidates domiciled in the respective Union Territory.

Post Domicile Requirement
Banking Associate UT of Jammu & Kashmir Domicile
Probationary Officer UT of Ladakh Domicile

Selected candidates must submit a valid domicile certificate issued by the competent authority during the prescribed verification process.

The base age limit for both Banking Associate and Probationary Officer is 20 to 30 years as on 1 January 2026, before applicable relaxation.

The Banking Associate recruitment involves an online examination conducted by IBPS, followed by provisional selection and document verification according to the bank's recruitment rules.

The notification does not prescribe a separate interview or Main Examination for Banking Associates.

Candidates must qualify in each section and meet the overall cut-off decided by IBPS in concurrence with J&K Bank.

These are minimum qualifying standards. The actual category-wise selection cut-offs may be higher.

Additional Marks for Former Bank Apprentices

Candidates domiciled in J&K who successfully completed apprenticeship training with J&K Bank will be awarded additional marks equal to 2.5% of the maximum marks in the online examination, as prescribed by the notification.

For the 100-mark online examination, this corresponds to 2.5 marks. This benefit is separate from the additional one-year age relaxation available to eligible former bank apprentices.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Selection Process 2026

The Probationary Officer recruitment consists of three stages:

  1. Preliminary Online Examination.
  2. Main Online Examination, including Objective and Descriptive Papers.
  3. Personal Interview.

Shortlisting to the Main Examination is generally limited to ten times the vacancies in each category, while shortlisting for interview is limited to three times the vacancies in each category, subject to the bank's recruitment provisions.

The Preliminary Examination is conducted in English and has separately timed sections.

Minimum Aggregate Qualifying Marks: 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved categories, subject to overall merit and sectional cut-offs.

Important: The PO Main Examination includes a descriptive paper assessing essay writing and comprehension, potentially covering economic, social, banking, technology, ethics and current-affairs topics.

Final Merit Weightage - Interview 20%

Final merit will be calculated using the Main Examination and Interview in an 80:20 ratio. Candidates must qualify in both stages.

Preliminary Examination marks are used for shortlisting and do not form part of the final merit calculation.

  1. Visit the official J&K Bank website at jkb.bank.in.
  2. Open the Careers section.
  3. Find the Banking Associate recruitment for UT of J&K or Probationary Officer recruitment for UT of Ladakh.

  6. Select Click Here for New Registration.

  16. Pay the applicable application fee and GST.

  18. Download the completed application form and payment receipt.
  19. Complete registration by 26 November 2026.

Important: Registration is complete only after successful fee payment. Candidates should retain the application receipt and login credentials for downloading examination call letters.

Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must hold a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government. Graduation must have been completed within the period specified by the bank.

Important Graduation Year Restriction: Candidates who completed graduation before 1 April 2022 are not eligible. Candidates whose graduation results were declared after 1 November 2026 are also not eligible.

Can Graduates from 2021 Apply?

No. Candidates who passed graduation before 1 April 2022 do not satisfy the passing-date requirement under the FY 2026-27 apprenticeship notification.

Can Final-Year Students Apply?

Only candidates whose final graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026 meet the notified qualification cut-off. Candidates awaiting their final result after that date are not eligible.

Previous Apprenticeship and Work Experience Restrictions

The bank does not permit applications from candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, are currently undergoing apprenticeship training or had their apprenticeship terminated due to their own fault.

Candidates who have accumulated one year or more of work experience after completing their educational qualification are also ineligible.

Indian Bank Apprentice Leave and Certification Rules

Apprentices are entitled to bank holidays and one casual leave after completing each month of training. A maximum of four casual leaves may be taken at one time.

The notification requires more than 338 paid days during the 12-month period to become eligible for the Certificate of Proficiency, subject to the prescribed assessment and completion conditions.

After successful training and assessment, the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will issue a digital Certificate of Proficiency through NATS 2.0.

Is Indian Bank Apprenticeship a Permanent Job?

No. Apprenticeship is a fixed-duration training arrangement. Indian Bank has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment after completion of training, and apprentices do not have a right to claim employment with the bank.

Indian Bank Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The selection procedure includes an online objective examination and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT). Indian Bank may also conduct an interview at its discretion.

  1. NATS Registration: Eligible candidates complete their apprenticeship registration and profile.
  2. Online Application: Candidates submit the application and pay the applicable fee.
  3. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the 100-mark objective examination.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test: Qualified candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the selected State/UT language unless exempt.
  5. Interview, If Conducted: The bank may include or dispense with an interview.
  6. Merit List: Candidates are ranked according to the applicable State/UT and category-wise merit rules.
  7. Document Verification: Eligibility and supporting certificates are verified.
  8. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to the bank's prescribed medical fitness requirements.
  9. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates receive their digital engagement through NATS 2.0.

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Qualifying Marks

Indian Bank will determine the minimum qualifying marks on the aggregate examination score. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for individual sections.

SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates receive a 5% relaxation in the prescribed aggregate qualifying percentage.

How Is the Indian Bank Apprentice Merit List Prepared?

The bank will prepare merit lists State/UT-wise and category-wise according to online examination performance.

Candidates will be ranked in descending order of aggregate marks. If candidates have identical marks at the cut-off, the older candidate will receive preference.

Where examinations are conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized using the equi-percentile method.

A State/UT-wise and category-wise waiting list may also be prepared to fill unoccupied apprenticeship seats.

Applicants can apply for only one State or Union Territory. During registration, candidates may choose three preferred districts within the selected State/UT.

The bank gives the applicant's resident district the first preference in the applicable merit arrangement, while candidates may select two additional neighbouring districts.

Important: District preferences do not guarantee posting in a particular branch or district. Indian Bank may allot candidates to any district within their selected State/UT according to availability and operational requirements.

How to Apply Online for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Open the Student Registration facility.
  3. Complete the enrolment process using the information requested on the portal.
  4. Enter accurate personal, contact and educational qualification details.
  5. Provide graduation passing information and other required certificates.
  6. Complete all mandatory profile sections until the NATS profile shows 100% completion.
  7. Save the generated NATS Enrolment ID.

Step 2 - Apply for Indian Bank Apprenticeship 2026

  1. Visit Indian Bank Careers or the NATS portal.
  2. Locate the recruitment titled Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank - 2026.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and verify the qualification, graduation passing date, age and experience restrictions.
  4. Open the corresponding online application facility.
  5. Click New Registration if registering for the recruitment for the first time.
  6. Enter your name, contact details and email address.
  7. Note the provisional registration number and password.
  8. Use the Save and Next facility while completing the application.
  9. Enter the required personal, address, graduation and category details.
  10. Select one eligible State/UT.
  11. Choose the preferred districts within that State/UT.
  12. Select one of the prescribed local languages for the language proficiency requirement.
  13. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  14. Complete the additional details requested by the application form.
  15. Open the Preview tab and carefully verify all entered information.
  16. Select Complete Registration after confirming the details.
  17. Pay the applicable fee through the online payment facility.
  18. Complete the application by 25 November 2026.
  19. Save the application printout and payment confirmation for future reference.

Indian Bank Apprentice Handwritten Declaration 2026

The handwritten declaration must be written in English on white paper using black ink. It must be written in the candidate's own handwriting and must not be written entirely in capital letters.

The official declaration is:

I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.

Candidates should reproduce the declaration exactly as prescribed in Annexure II of the official notification.

The online examination will be conducted at various centres across India. The tentative examination centre list is provided in Annexure I of the official advertisement.

Candidates can indicate their preferred examination centre while applying, subject to the options provided by the application form. However, Indian Bank may allot a different centre according to availability.

Requests for examination centre changes will not be entertained. Candidates must bear their own examination-related travel expenses.

Indian Bank Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Indian Bank will issue examination call letters through its official website or other recruitment-related portals identified in the notification.

Candidates must download their call letters using the registration number or roll number and the required login credentials.

Call letters will not be sent by post. Applicants should regularly check their registered email and the official bank recruitment website for examination updates.

Indian Bank Apprentice Certificate and Contract Conditions

Selected candidates will receive a digital apprenticeship engagement offer through NATS 2.0. The apprenticeship contract is normally for 12 months and terminates automatically after completion of the prescribed training period.

Candidates must report at the allotted bank branch or training venue on the specified joining date. Failure to report may lead to termination of the apprenticeship contract.

Early Termination of Apprenticeship

The advertisement specifies conditions for early termination of the apprenticeship contract, including voluntary withdrawal, misconduct, employment elsewhere and medical inability to continue training.

A candidate who voluntarily leaves the training before completing the contract may be required to pay an amount equivalent to one month's stipend, under the notified conditions.

Separate provisions apply to termination after securing gainful employment or due to medical grounds. Candidates should read the full contractual conditions before accepting the apprenticeship.

  • Online applications are open from 5 November to 25 November 2026.
  • Graduation in any discipline is required.

  • The age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation.
  • Candidates with one year or more of post-qualification work experience are not eligible.
  • Applicants who have already undergone apprenticeship training are ineligible.
  • Only one State/UT can be selected.
  • Candidates must maintain a fully completed NATS 2.0 profile.
  • The application fee is Rs. 800 or Rs. 175 plus GST, depending on category.
  • Selection includes a 100-mark online test and Local Language Proficiency Test.
  • The bank may conduct an interview at its discretion.
  • Local language exemption is available with the prescribed school-study evidence.
  • The stipend depends on whether the allotted branch is Metro/Urban or Rural/Semi-Urban.
  • Training lasts for 12 months.
  • Apprenticeship does not guarantee regular or contractual employment.
  • Ex-Servicemen and Disabled Ex-Servicemen are not eligible under the notification.
  • Candidates must satisfy document verification and medical fitness requirements.
  • The bank may revise the training seats, selection requirements or schedule through official updates.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Notification: State Bank of India (SBI) has released Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/28 for 60 Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) vacancies under Specialist Cadre Officer recruitment on a regular basis. Candidates must be graduates with the prescribed experience as officers in the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force or paramilitary forces. The age limit is 25 to 40 years as on 31 October 2026, with applicable relaxation. The starting basic pay is Rs. 85,920 for Manager and Rs. 64,820 for Deputy Manager. Online applications are open from 4 November to 25 November 2026 through the official SBI Careers website at sbi.bank.in.

Important: This recruitment is intended for candidates with qualifying military or paramilitary officer experience. Graduation without the prescribed service experience does not meet the eligibility requirements. Applicants must also possess medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent category.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must have completed graduation from a Government-recognized university or institution and possess the specified experience as commissioned officers in the Armed Forces or officers in paramilitary forces.

The educational qualification alone does not establish eligibility. Candidates must also meet the respective service rank, experience and medical fitness requirements as on 31 October 2026.

SBI Manager (Security) Experience Requirements

Candidates applying for Manager (Security) in MMGS-III must satisfy either of the following conditions:

  • An officer not below the rank of Major in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 10 years of commissioned service.
  • An officer not below the rank of Deputy Commandant in paramilitary forces, with at least 10 years of service as an officer in the force.

SBI Deputy Manager (Security) Experience Requirements

Candidates applying for Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-II must satisfy either of the following conditions:

  • An officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 5 years of commissioned service.
  • An officer not below the rank of Assistant Commandant in paramilitary forces, with at least 5 years of service as an officer in the force.

SBI SO Medical Fitness Requirement

Only candidates possessing medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent medical category as on the release date of the advertisement are eligible.

Retired candidates must upload the relevant medical category information from their discharge book or service record. Candidates currently serving must upload their latest Medical Board document indicating their medical category.

SBI SO Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview. The final merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Professional Knowledge and 30% to the interview.

  1. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the objective examination.
  2. Shortlisting: SBI shortlists candidates based on the examination results and applicable requirements.
  3. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates attend an interview carrying 100 marks.
  4. Document Verification: Educational qualifications, service experience, medical fitness and category certificates are verified.
  5. Final Merit List: Prepared using normalized Professional Knowledge and interview marks.

SBI reserves the right to modify the selection process, including considering shortlisting followed by interview, if required.

SBI SO Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination contains 200 objective questions carrying 200 marks, with a total duration of two hours.

Important SBI SO Exam Rules

  • Reasoning Ability, English Language and General Awareness are qualifying in nature.
  • Marks obtained in these three qualifying sections are not counted toward final merit.
  • Candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks fixed by SBI in the applicable sections.
  • Professional Knowledge carries 100 marks and contributes to final merit.
  • There is no negative marking for incorrect answers.

If candidates have the same score at the cut-off point, SBI will rank them according to age in descending order.

SBI Security Officer Job Responsibilities

Selected Manager and Deputy Manager (Security) officers will be responsible for improving security arrangements at SBI branches and offices.

  • Conduct periodic security audits of branches and offices.
  • Review existing security arrangements and recommend improvements.
  • Organize security drills, lectures and employee awareness programmes.
  • Monitor security systems and reduce incidents caused by security lapses.
  • Support implementation of disaster management plans.
  • Visit branches and other administrative units to assess security requirements.
  • Coordinate with civil, military, police and other Government authorities.
  • Perform additional security administration duties assigned by SBI.

Selected officers may be posted or transferred to SBI offices anywhere in India according to the Bank's requirements.

ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute, Coimbatore – 641007, describes itself on its letterhead as an ISO 9001:2008 certified Institute of ICAR. The notification is issued by Dinesh Nagpal, Chief Administrative Officer.

Posts and Eligibility

The only position advertised is Project Fellow. The appointment runs from the date of joining to 31.03.2027 or until the projects end (co-terminus), whichever is earlier. The emoluments are Rs.20,000/- per month (consolidated).

Essential Qualification

Three or Four years Bachelor degree in B.Sc / B.Tech from a recognized university in any of the following:

  • Agriculture biotechnology
  • Plant Breeding and Genetics
  • Biotechnology
  • Life Sciences
  • Basic Sciences

What to Bring

Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) Graduate from recognised University/Institution MBA/PGDM in Management/Marketing/Finance/Banking, CAIIB or other relevant professional qualification

APCOB Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) Job Description

The notice lists the roles and responsibilities under ten heads:

  • Business Strategy, Planning and Growth: formulate business development strategies and plans for APCOB and DCCBs, drive growth in deposits, advances and fee-based income, monitor performance against targets, build models using the DCCB–PACS network as a last-mile channel, and develop annual/quarterly business KRAs.
  • Deposit, CASA, Credit and Institutional Business Development: strengthen low-cost deposits and CASA, find branches below potential, identify Government Departments, Corporations, educational institutions, temples and local bodies for deposit business, and expand asset business.
  • Product Development, Digital Business and Customer Proposition: facilitate deposit, loan and other products, develop distinctive customer value propositions ("WOW" factors), and promote digital banking and alternate delivery channels.
  • Customer Segmentation and Rural Market Development: segment customers by occupation, livelihood, cropping patterns, income and banking behaviour, and target farmers, agricultural labourers, tenant farmers, SHGs, JLGs, FPOs, rural artisans, rural youth and pensioners.
  • DCCB and Branch Business Transformation: assess DCCB potential, study branches with low business/viability, and replicate successful practices across branches and DCCBs.
  • Marketing, Customer Acquisition and Business Partnerships: marketing and branding strategies, customer acquisition and retention, and institutional tie-ups and partnerships.
  • Market Intelligence, Benchmarking and Business Analytics: benchmark against leading commercial banks and analyse business data and market trends for Management.
  • Field Engagement, Capacity Building and Implementation Support: field visits to APCOB branches, DCCBs and DCCB branches across the State, workshops and training, and mentoring of branches.
  • Profitable Growth, Risk Alignment and Performance Governance: keep growth aligned with asset quality, regulatory requirements, approved policies and risk appetite, and submit periodic reports to Senior Management.
  • Other Responsibilities: other business development functions assigned by the Senior Management/Board of Management from time to time.

  5. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CBDO, APCOB & DCCBs." on top of the envelope.

There is one vacancy of Consultant for Information Technology Department. The cut-off date for age, qualification and experience is 01.11.2026.

  • Educational qualification (mandatory): Engineering Graduate or MCA or equivalent qualification from a recognized University / Institution.
  • Educational qualification (desirable): Master degree or equivalent in IT Management.
  • Post qualification work experience (mandatory): a minimum of 5 years at Senior level (General Manager cadre and above) in Public Sector Banks or equivalent in reputed Private Sector Banks / reputed Financial Institutions / Leading IT service firms, OR a minimum of 5 years as Professor in IIT/IIIT/IISc/ NIT.
  • Last assignment should have been one of these:
    • as Head / In charge of Information Technology operations in Public Sector Banks / reputed Private Sector Banks / reputed Financial Institutions and not below the level of General Manager cadre of Public Sector Bank or its equivalent; OR
    • as Head of operations / Senior level positions (equivalent to General Manager cadre of Public Sector Bank) from Leading IT service firms having exposure in Banking and Core Banking Solutions related areas; OR
    • as Professor/Head of Information Technology Department or its equivalent discipline in IIT/IIIT/IISc/ NIT.
  • Desirable experience: Banking-IT related areas / projects involving IT Policy and Planning / Financial Networks and Applications / Financial Information Systems / Cyber Security Technologies / Payment Technologies / AI / Emerging Technologies.
  • Others: no vigilance case or adverse observation from previous employer / CVC / RBI shall be pending against the candidate.
  • Age: Minimum Age – 50 Years and Maximum Age - 65 years (inclusive of all relaxations) as on 01.11.2026.
  • Remuneration & Perquisites: Negotiable – CTC based pay structure in the form of Fixed pay and Variable pay.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full wording of the eligibility conditions for this post.

Period of Engagement and Place of Work

  • The engagement is on Fixed Term Employment (FTE) on contractual basis for an initial period of six (06) months, extendable for further periods of six months at a time as per the needs and requirements of the Bank, based on review after every six months.
  • In no case should the total tenure exceed a continuous term of 5 years in the Bank.
  • Termination: one month's notice or one month's fixed component of the compensation in lieu of such notice from either of the parties, at the sole discretion of the Bank.
  • Place of work: at present Chennai – a minimum of six (06) days in each calendar month physically at Head Quarters in Chennai, and continuous availability through virtual medium on all other occasions as decided by the Bank.

Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 Job Description

The Consultant will provide consultation for:

  • The profitability/advantages vs Risk for all IT, Digital, Information Security, AI, DPDP related projects to be analysed and reviewed by the Consultant along with the Bank's representative(s).
  • Reviewing the existing policies related to IT, Digital, Digitisation, Analytics, Information Security, AI, DPDP to suggest enhancements and assist the bank in preparation of new policies like Fintech Partnership policy, AI & ML adoption policy etc.
  • Suggesting strategies and opportunities to enhance customer experience.
  • Identifying new avenues in Digital transformation and automation which will guide the Bank to provide customer delight.
  • Assisting with the strategies to revamp of Core Banking Solution 'BaNCS' in process optimisations, hollow the core, infrastructure revamp etc. (M/s TCS is the OEM of BaNCS).
  • Assisting in complying with IT, Digital and Information/Cyber security related Guidelines/Directions from RBI, NPCI, DFS, Cert-In, IBA etc.
  • Providing guidance to close observations in reports of various IS Audits, VAPT, RBI IT Examination etc, which may involve seeking exemption, procurement & implementation, etc.
  • Identification and implementation of new technologies and technology products.
  • Development of enterprises technology standards, governance processes and performance metrics to ensure that IT delivers value to enterprise.
  • Monitoring & Managing Core IT Infrastructure, Network, Business applications and related IT Operations of the Bank.
  • Supporting the business department and meeting their needs in a time bound manner.
  • Providing Industry Expertise for the IT initiatives of the Bank.
  • Optimization and management of existing information technology network for high efficiency with sufficient resilience and yet managing costs effectively.
  • Development of long-term plans to sustain and support the business, anticipating the future trends.
  • Ensuring that there is no failure in business operations and appropriate disaster recovery plans are in place and regularly tested for readiness for unforeseen and unexpected events which can impact the business continuity.
  • Ensuring that all IT assets achieve full life time cycle value.
  • Maintaining relationships and extract maximum efficiency from the Bank's technology partners who support various IT applications.
  • Compliance to IT security policies as well as regulatory prescriptions.
  • Evaluation of the cost efficiency of emerging technologies and assess their applicability to various business and technology solutions.
  • Building quality assurance, data protection processes and robust Technology Management systems.
  • Identifying security threats, formulate strategies and solutions to mitigate the threats.
  • Monitoring KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and IT budgets to assess technological performance on IT front.
  • Using stakeholders' feedback for necessary improvements and adjustments in technology. Increase in operational efficiency.
  • Designing of systems and interfaces for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaboration, on-boarding and management of vendors that supply solutions to enhance the Bank's products and services.

The notice states that this job description is only illustrative and not exhaustive, and other jobs may be assigned from time to time.

If the number of applicants is substantially large, a Written Test / Group Discussion / Preliminary Interview or a combination of these may be adopted.
