About PSB

Punjab & Sind Bank describes itself as a Govt. of India Undertaking, with its Head Office HRD Department at NBCC Building Block 3, Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023. The Chief Risk Officer will oversee risk management across the Bank, including at group level covering Domestic Operations, Domestic Subsidiaries and Branches.

Who Can Apply

Nationality

A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam intending to settle permanently. The last four groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Govt. of India.

Essential qualification and experience (as on 17.11.2026)

  • Graduate Degree from a university/institution recognised by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies.
  • At least five years' experience in Corporate Credit and Risk Management at the level of Assistant General Manager or above in one or more Public Sector Banks; or in an equivalent senior position, with similar roles and responsibilities, in one or more regulated lending entities, as may be determined by the Bank and the CRO Selection Committee, with minimum experience of one year in Corporate Credit and one year in Risk Management.
  • Along with any one of: (a) professional certification in financial risk management from the Global Association of Risk Professionals; (b) Professional Risk Management Certification from the PRMIA Institute; or at least two years' experience as Chief Risk Officer in a regulated lending entity where the CRO must be appointed with Board approval under a regulatory requirement.

Desirable

Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following:

  • Chartered Financial Analyst charter from the CFA Institute.
  • Chartered Accountant qualification from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad.
  • Cost and Management Accountant qualification from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad.
  • Postgraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Banking, Risk Management, Business Administration or a related field.
  • Certification or specialised qualification in treasury risk, credit risk, operational risk, cyber risk, climate risk, data analytics or model-risk management.
  • Desirable experience: good understanding of market risk and/or liquidity management and/or operational risk, with exposure to analytics an added advantage.

Age limit

Minimum 40 years of age and less than 55 years of age (as on 01.11.2026). The notice prints no age relaxation. Date of birth as per the Secondary School Certificate (SSC)/School leaving certificate must confirm age eligibility.

Pay and Terms

  • Pay: the compensation and terms and conditions will be negotiated/finalised depending upon the suitability of the candidate.
  • Tenure: the CRO may initially be engaged for a fixed contractual tenure of three years, extendable by one year at a time, up to a maximum of five years, subject to annual performance review by the Board/Risk Management Committee of the Board.
  • The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to claim regular employment or absorption in the Bank.
  • Working hours and weekly off/holidays are as applicable to the Bank's serving employees.
  • Leave: 30 days' paid leave per calendar year, not more than 05 days at a time. Absence beyond 30 days in a contract year leads to a proportionate deduction from the consolidated payment, and unavailed leave lapses at the end of the contract year.
  • PF, Gratuity, Pension etc. do not apply, and no other allowance, payment, benefit or facility is payable beyond what the notice mentions.
  • Location: preferably Head Office/Corporate Office; the Bank reserves the right to post the candidate to any office in India depending on administrative requirements.

PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER Job Description

The CRO oversees the entire risk management process of the Bank, including at group level, reviews risk models, and develops policies, procedures and pricing models. The role is grouped under credit risk, market risk, operational risk, and liquidity and interest rate risk management, and also includes RBI guidelines applicable from time to time. Annexure I of the notice lists these duties:

  • Act as risk assessor and overall in charge of the Bank's Risk Management function, and advise top management.
  • Implement and maintain an enterprise-wide integrated risk management and governance framework covering credit, investment, operational, market and compliance risk.
  • Report the Bank's risk profile periodically to Risk Committees, top management and the Board, and implement BASEL guidelines as per RBI directives.
  • Oversee the Fraud Risk Management Department (FRMD) and strengthen frameworks including EIRMS, policy and cyber risk governance.
  • Credit risk: bank-wide credit risk management, risk limits and risk appetite, stress testing, preparation of the Annual ICAAP document, monitoring of large exposures, and validation of Credit Risk Assessment (CRA)/scoring models.
  • Market risk: turn the Board's framework into policies and procedures, and guide the market risk team on interest rate risk, equity price risk, derivatives, country limits, counterparty bank limits and stress testing.
  • Operational risk: supervise the ORM Cell, review operational risk policies, conduct the Product and Process Approval Committee, Credit Policy Committee, ALCO and ORMC meetings, oversee AML/CFT controls and IT security risk, and ensure Board RMC meetings are held as scheduled.
  • Liquidity and interest rate risk: oversee the liquidity position of all PSB Zones and departments, supervise the ALM Cell and review the Asset Liability Management Policy.

The notice adds that any other roles and responsibilities may be assigned by the authorities/Bank.

How to Apply for PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER

  1. Log on to the Bank's website https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and, on the Home Page under the link "Recruitment", click the relevant Notification. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Before registering, keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active until the appointment process ends. Call letters are sent to the registered email ID.
  3. Spell your name and your father's/husband's name exactly as in your certificates, mark sheets and identity proof. Any change found may disqualify the candidature.
  4. Pay the application fee online only. Cash, Demand Drafts, Cheques, Money Orders and Postal Stamps are not accepted.
  5. Submit the application by 17.11.2026. Applications received after the stipulated date and incomplete applications are rejected.

Application fee

The fee is Rs. 1000/- + GST as applicable. The table prints Rs. 1180/- (including CGST and SGST) for New Delhi and Rs. 1180/- (including IGST) for out of New Delhi. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be held in reserve for any other selection. An application cannot be withdrawn once made.

Documents named in the notice

  • Scanned photograph and signature as per the guidelines in the advertisement; image formats .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp, .gif.
  • Scanned thumb impression and handwritten declaration: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Education, experience, reservation certificates and date of birth proof, scanned in PDF format only.
  • Original documents at the interview; candidates will not be allowed to participate without them. Copies of the same passport-size photograph are to be brought for the interview.

Selection Process

The selection process may broadly comprise preliminary scrutiny of applications, shortlisting, a personal interaction/interview before the Selection Committee, and verification of credentials. Final selection is on marks obtained in the interview, by merit ranking.

  • Scrutiny: applications are checked against age, qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions.
  • Shortlisting: based on relevant experience, seniority, professional credentials and suitability, and on academic track record. Only shortlisted candidates are called. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called.
  • Interview: assesses knowledge of credit, market, operational, liquidity, technology, cyber, climate and other material risks, plus leadership ability, independence of judgement, regulatory awareness and ability to interact with the Board and senior management.
  • Verification of credentials, vigilance status, integrity, reputation and antecedents.

The interview venue, date and time will be informed in the call letter, sent by email only. Candidates attend at their own cost. The notice mentions no written test.

  • Candidates serving in Government/Public Sector Undertakings including Banks must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview, failing which the candidature will not be considered.
  • The selected candidate must produce a valid discharge/relieving letter from the present employer before joining.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness, the required qualifications and experience, and clearances, verifications and background checks.
  • The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary with the Bank's requirement.
  • If several applications are made, only the last valid complete application is retained.
  • Requests to change the interview date, time or venue will not be entertained.
  • The Bank may change, add or cancel the selection process, or cancel the whole process, and will announce this on its website or by email.
  • False information or suppressed facts lead to cancellation, forfeiture of fee and possible termination after appointment. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification.
  • Any dispute is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts at Delhi, and the English version prevails.

SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description

GM & Chief AI Officer

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and operations of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, and parsing tools to improve operational efficiency and mitigate risk.
  • Design and implement big data scalable workflow systems including Enterprise AI Platform for generative and agentic AI.
  • Deliver AI solutions at scale with operational and analytical integrations including Cloudera Data Lakehouse and enterprise API platforms.
  • Deliver new functionality for internal production and client delivery platforms.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Business, Quality Assurance, Data Operation, and IT Infrastructure.
  • Oversee business collaboration via permanent control towers for AI/data products and ensure seamless integration into formal business processes.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory norms and align with Bank governance standards and top management directives.
  • Oversee independent model validation team and evaluate ongoing risk and performance in models.

DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics)

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Bank's risk and operational analytics function and establish an enterprise-wide roadmap across Risk, Compliance, Business, and Operations.
  • Lead design, development, validation, implementation, and operations of AI/ML models for early-warning systems, collections, fraud prevention, operational risk, financial risk, and process optimization.
  • Integrate analytical models and decision engines into core banking, loan origination, and operational workflows via enterprise data and API platforms.
  • Establish human-in-the-loop controls, override mechanisms, audit trails, and escalation procedures for material decisions.
  • Prioritise high-impact use cases based on loss reduction, regulatory importance, customer impact, efficiency, and feasibility.
  • Drive responsible adoption of generative and agentic AI for risk intelligence, document analysis, and operational decision support.

DGM (AI Governance and Compliance)

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Bank's AI governance and compliance function across ML, generative AI, and agentic AI.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce AI governance policies, standards, risk-classification methodologies, and control frameworks.
  • Oversee independent validation, periodic review, and governance controls for material models and AI-enabled systems.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable RBI directions, Digital Personal Data Protection Act and Rules, and information security norms.
  • Coordinate AI risk assessments, privacy impact assessments, security reviews, and approval processes before production deployment.
  • Oversee third-party AI governance, vendor due diligence, contractual safeguards, and data-use restrictions.
  • Convene or support governance committees and coordinate regulatory inspections and audit closures.

DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops)

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead data engineering, model application development, and AI Ops functions to deliver scalable, secure data and AI pipelines.
  • Design, develop, and operate enterprise data pipelines, model-serving platforms, and APIs in coordination with GITC.
  • Establish engineering standards for MLOps, LLMOps, DevSecOps, testing, CI/CD, and release management.
  • Automate deployment, monitoring, rollback, recalibration, and retirement for AI/ML models and agentic AI applications.
  • Implement observability covering availability, latency, throughput, data quality, performance, capacity, and compute utilisation.
  • Manage technology vendors, systems integrators, and platform providers.

AI Solution Architect

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business units and technology teams to identify, conceptualize, design, and implement scalable AI solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into AI solution concepts, functional blueprints, and user journeys.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, enterprise architects, and application teams to develop implementable technical designs.
  • Define AI risk controls, guardrails, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and explainability requirements.
  • Support development of business cases, evaluate alternative approaches, and guide PoCs and pilots.
  • Create reusable solution patterns, templates, and blueprints for common AI use cases across the Bank.

Enterprise AI Architect

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Define, govern, and evolve the Bank's enterprise AI architecture strategy and on-premises NVIDIA-based AI platform.
  • Design and optimize GPU infrastructure and workload architectures leveraging NVIDIA AI Enterprise ecosystem.
  • Lead architectural design of Generative AI, LLM solutions, RAG, and vector databases.
  • Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, model gateways, model serving mechanisms, and API integration strategies.
  • Architect secure and scalable enterprise data platforms and enforce technology standards, security, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and manage architecture exceptions.

How to Apply for SBI Recruitment 2026

Candidates must submit their applications online through the official careers portal of State Bank of India. No hard copy of the application or documents needs to be sent by post.

  1. Visit the official SBI careers portal and navigate to the current openings page.
  2. Locate the link for Specialist Cadre Officers recruitment under advertisement CRPD/SCO/2026-27/30.
  3. Register online by entering basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password. The facility for editing saved application details is available up to three times only before final submission.
  4. Fill in the online application form carefully with educational, professional, and personal details.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, biodata, resume, ID proof, age proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, salary slips/Form-16, and other required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 750/- (exempted for SC/ST/PwBD) online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
  7. Submit the completed application form and print a copy of the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Document Upload Specifications:

  • Photograph: Recent passport style colour picture (20 kb to 50 kb, JPG/JPEG format, preferred dimensions 200 x 230 pixels, light-coloured or white background).
  • Signature: Signed on white paper with Black Ink pen (10 kb to 20 kb, JPG/JPEG format, preferred dimensions 140 x 60 pixels; signatures in capital letters are not accepted).
  • Other Documents: Biodata, Resume, ID proof, Proof of Date of Birth, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates, Caste/EWS/PwBD certificate (if applicable), Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary Slip, and CTC negotiation sheet must be uploaded in PDF format on A4 size, with file size not exceeding 500 kb each.

Queries: For any queries, candidates can write via the "CONTACT US/ Post Your Query" link available on the Bank's website (https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/post-your-query) or email [email protected].

Selection and Interview

The selection process comprises three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, and CTC Negotiation.

  • Shortlisting: Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide shortlisting parameters to call an adequate number of candidates.
  • Interview (100 Marks): The interview carries 100 marks. For the posts of GM & Chief AI officer, DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics), DGM (AI Governance and Compliance), and DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops), shortlisted candidates must deliver a 10-minute presentation on their relevant job profile, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved. Qualifying marks in the interview are decided by the Bank. Intimation or call letters for the interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email; no hard copy will be sent.
  • CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation is conducted one-by-one with candidates at the time of interview or separately after the interview process.
  • Merit List: The final merit list is prepared in descending order based solely on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in cut-off marks, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order.

Travelling Allowance for Interview: Outstation candidates called for interview after shortlisting will be reimbursed the cost of travelling by Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route in India as follows:

  • GM & Chief AI officer and all three DGM posts (Sl. No. 1 to 4): Reimbursement of actual Air Fare (Economy Class).
  • AI Solution Architect and Enterprise AI Architect (Sl. No. 5 & 6): Reimbursement of Air Fare up to Rs. 15,000/- (Total for both sides) or actual fare, whichever is lower.
  • Note: In case a candidate called for interview is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification, Experience, etc.), he/she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled to reimbursement of any travelling expenses.

About NaBFID

The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

Where and How to Send

NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent.

  1. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description.
  2. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph.
  3. Send the CV by email to [email protected].
  4. Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16.
  5. Make sure the email is received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.

Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The advertisement covers a single post in the grade of Executive Vice President: Sl. No. 01, EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk, Job Code NABFID/EVP/16, 1 vacancy (UR).

Educational Qualification

  • Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account.
  • Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute.

Experience

  • Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector.
  • Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity).
  • Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level.
  • Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred.

Age Limit

The age limit is 55 years and below, as on the date of advertisement. After applying all relaxations in terms of age, the maximum age of candidates shall not exceed 55 years. Candidates should satisfy themselves about their eligibility as on the cut-off date, 3 November 2026.

Nationality

The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens.

Pay and Terms of Engagement

  • Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice.
  • Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank.
  • Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement.
  • Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.

Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

  • Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework.

  • Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose.
  • Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee, and its decision will be final.

The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.

Pay and Tenure

The posts are on Contract/Deputation/Post-superannuation basis for a minimum period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the standard terms and conditions of the organization. For deputation, pay is as per standard terms and conditions.

Apart from the pay, other benefits are paid as per Company Policy, and selected candidates get Group medical coverage and Group personal accident insurance as per GMRCL policies. For IDA/CDA scale employees, the percentage of HRA may vary with the place of posting as per Government guidelines and company policy.

How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026

Only online applications are accepted, through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com. The notice gives these steps.

  2. Log in with the passcode sent to the email ID given at registration.
  3. Select the position for which you are applying.
  4. Fill in the online application with details from latest to earliest, and complete the application form.

Selection and Interview

The selection process comprises Personal Interviews followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. It judges different facets of knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness.

  • Preference is given to candidates with experience in the same grade or immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in the grade. If sufficient suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale who meet the prescribed qualifications, total experience and age criteria may be considered.

How to Calculate Marks Using MPSC Assistant Engineer Answer Key 2026?

Candidates can compare their attempted answers with the provisional answer keys to estimate their performance in the objective examination. The calculation should follow the official marking scheme applicable to each paper.

  1. Download the provisional answer key for your paper.
  2. Select the correct question booklet series.
  3. Compare your responses with the published answers.
  4. Count the correct and incorrect responses.
  5. Apply the officially notified marks for correct answers and any applicable negative marking.
  6. Calculate your estimated score.

Note: The answer key notification does not specify the marks awarded per correct answer or the negative marking rules. Candidates should refer to the official examination scheme before calculating their scores.

MPSC has provided an online facility for candidates to submit objections against the provisional answer keys. Only candidates who appeared in the Assistant Engineer/Manager written examination are eligible to raise objections.

The objection portal will accept claims from 16 November 2026 until 5:00 PM on 20 November 2026. Candidates must provide supporting evidence and complete the prescribed online payment before final submission.

How to Raise Objections Against MPSC Assistant Engineer Answer Key 2026?

Candidates who disagree with a provisional answer must submit their objection through the designated MPSC online portal. The commission requires a justification supported by authentic reference material.

  1. Visit the official objection portal at empsconline.gov.in/CandidateCentre/ViewQues.aspx.
  2. Enter your Application Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Open the question you wish to challenge.
  4. Review the question and corresponding provisional answer displayed on the screen.
  5. Select the answer you consider correct.
  6. Provide a justification with relevant textbook or authentic source details, including the book title and page number where applicable.
  7. Upload the required supporting documents in PDF format.
  8. Pay the objection fee of Rs. 300 per question through the online payment facility.
  9. Complete the final submission within the prescribed deadline.

Important: Objections without adequate supporting evidence may be rejected. The commission will not accept objection documents in formats other than PDF or submissions through alternative methods.

Candidates can estimate their Tier-I raw marks by comparing their responses with the provisional answer key and applying the official marking scheme.

SSC CGL Tier-I Raw Score = (Correct Answers × 2) – (Incorrect Answers × 0.50)

For example, if a candidate has 75 correct answers, 15 incorrect answers and 10 unattempted questions, the estimated raw score would be:

(75 × 2) – (15 × 0.50) = 142.50 marks

The calculated score is only an estimate. SSC may apply normalisation for examinations conducted in multiple shifts, and accepted objections may affect the final evaluation.

The SSC CGL Tier-I examination was conducted across multiple dates and shifts. The official recruitment notification provides for normalisation of examination scores where multiple shifts are conducted.

Candidates should understand that the raw marks calculated using the provisional answer key may differ from the normalised marks used by SSC for determining merit and applicable cut-off marks.

The official recruitment notification explains that the final answer key will be used for processing the computer-based examination result and will be uploaded after the result declaration.

Candidates qualifying the Tier-I examination according to the applicable criteria will be considered for the next stage, Tier-II. The Commission will publish the result and relevant cut-off information through its official website.

How to Download MP Police SI Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official MPESB website at esb.mp.gov.in.

  3. Find the link for Subedar and SI Recruitment Test 2026.
  4. Click the Objection Tracker Login link.

  6. Enter your date of birth in DDMMYYYY format.
  7. Fill in the displayed captcha code.
  8. Click the Submit or Login button.
  9. Your answer key and response sheet will appear on the screen.
  10. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

How to Raise Objections Against MP SI Answer Key 2026

Candidates who find an incorrect answer in the provisional key can submit objections online through the MPESB objection tracker between 10 and 13 November 2026.

  1. Visit the official MPESB website at esb.mp.gov.in.
  2. Open the Online Question / Answer Objection section.
  3. Select Subedar and Sub-Inspector Recruitment Test 2026.
  4. Click the Objection Tracker Login link.
  5. Enter your application number, TAC code and date of birth.
  6. Enter the captcha code and log in.
  7. Select the question you want to challenge.
  8. Choose the appropriate answer or option and add supporting documents wherever applicable.
  9. Pay the prescribed objection fee, if applicable, as displayed on the portal.
  10. Submit the objection and save the acknowledgement receipt.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Submit objections within the window. The last date is 13 November 2026.
  • Provide valid supporting documents wherever the portal asks for them.
  • The objection fee, if applicable, is shown on the portal. The amount is not available in the official notification/source.
  • Save the acknowledgement receipt after submitting an objection.
  • Download and save your response sheet PDF for future reference.
  • The marking scheme, including any negative marking, is not available in the official notification/source. Check the official rules before calculating your expected score.

Information Not Yet Available

  • Marking scheme and negative marking
  • Objection fee amount
  • List of supporting documents accepted for objections

Is the Rajasthan SET Final Answer Key 2026 Out?

Yes, according to a published on 6 November 2026. The University of Kota has published subject-wise final answer keys on the SET result page of its official website. Candidates should open uok.ac.in and confirm the latest notice before relying on any third-party page.

The final answer key is prepared after the university reviews the objections received against the provisional key. Candidates cannot assume that every answer from the 5 October key remains unchanged, so recheck your answers against the final version.

How to Download the Rajasthan SET Final Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official University of Kota website at uok.ac.in.
  2. Open the SET Examination 2026 section.
  3. Look for the result and final answer key link.
  4. Select your subject from the list.
  5. The subject-wise PDF will open. No login is required for the Master Set PDFs on the university page.
  6. Download the PDF and save it for reference.

Provisional Answer Key vs Final Answer Key: What Is the Difference?

Point Provisional Answer Key Final Answer Key
Release Date 5 October 2026 6 November 2026
Purpose Lets candidates match answers and raise objections Used as the basis for the result
Can Change? Yes, after objections are reviewed Treated as the final version

Rajasthan SET 2026 Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme

Paper Subject Questions Marks Duration
Paper I Teaching and Research Aptitude (General) 50 100 1 hour
Paper II Candidate's chosen subject 100 200 2 hours
  • All questions are multiple choice and compulsory.
  • Each correct answer carries 2 marks.
  • There is no negative marking.
  • There is no break between the two papers.
  • The exam was held in a single session from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

How to Check Your Expected Score Using the Answer Key

  1. Download the final answer key for your subject.
  2. Match each of your marked answers with the key.
  3. Give 2 marks for every correct answer.
  4. Do not deduct marks for wrong or unattempted questions.
  5. Add up the marks for Paper I and Paper II.

This gives only an expected score. Your official marks and qualifying status are decided by the University of Kota in the result.

Re-Examination Notice for Certain Centres

University of Kota has announced a re-examination for candidates of Centre Codes 4057 and 4066. Other pages mention a re-exam on 27 September 2026, but the sources differ. Candidates from these centres should read the re-examination notice on uok.ac.in for the exact details.

What to Do After the Rajasthan SET Final Answer Key

  • Check your result and qualifying status on uok.ac.in.
  • Download and save the result and answer key PDFs.
  • Read the official notice for certificate or document-related instructions, if any are issued.
  • Candidates of the re-exam centres should follow the re-examination notice.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Download files only from the official University of Kota website.
  • Do not rely on unofficial dates or messages on social media.
  • Keep your application number and roll number ready when checking your result.
  • Details not announced by the university, such as cut-off marks or objection dates, should be treated as not available until published officially.

The provisional answers are available through the Master Question Paper on the official UPESSC website. The objection window is open from 5 November to 12 November 2026. UP Special TET Answer Key 2026 Important Dates

UP Special TET 2026 Exam 3 November 2026
Provisional Answer Key and Objection Window Opens 5 November 2026

UP Special TET Answer Key 2026 PDF Download

The answer keys for Paper 1 and Paper 2 are available separately, and each is arranged by booklet series. Candidates should open the key that matches the paper they appeared in and the series code printed on their question booklet. Checking against the wrong series is the most common reason for a wrong score estimate.

How to Download the UP Special TET Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official UPESSC website at upessc.up.gov.in.
  2. Open the UP Special TET exam portal tab on the homepage.
  3. Log in with your roll number and date of birth.
  4. Click the link for the UP Special TET provisional answer key 2026.
  5. Select your paper, Paper 1 or Paper 2.
  6. Choose your booklet series code: A, B, C or D.
  7. Open the PDF, then download and save it for reference.

How to Raise Objection Against UP Special TET Answer Key 2026

Objections are accepted only through the online objection window on the official UPESSC portal. A valid justification or reference is required for every question you challenge.

  1. Open the official UPESSC website and go to the UP Special TET 2026 objection portal.
  2. Log in with your roll number and date of birth in DDMMYYYY format.
  3. Select the question you want to challenge.
  4. Choose the objection type from the dropdown menu shown against that question.
  5. Enter a valid justification or reference in the text box.
  6. Submit one or more objections, then check them under the View Objection Summary option. You can print the summary using the print icon.
  7. Pay the prescribed fee online through the payment option under the View Objection Summary tab.

UP Special TET Answer Key Objection Fee

The objection fee is payable per question and online. Two different amounts are in circulation: ₹100 per question and approximately ₹500 per question. The amount is Not Confirmed Officially on this page. Pay only the amount displayed on the objection portal at the time of submission, and keep the payment confirmation until the final answer key is published.

What to Attach or Mention as Proof

Support each objection with a clear justification and a reference, such as a page from a standard NCERT or SCERT textbook. A specific reference is more useful to the review than a general statement that the answer is wrong.

How to Calculate Your Probable Score Using the UP Special TET Answer Key

  1. Download the key for your paper and your booklet series.
  2. Compare each of your marked answers with the provisional key.
  3. Award 1 mark for every correct answer.
  4. Do not deduct marks for wrong or unattempted questions, as there is no negative marking.
  5. Add up the marks. Your total is out of 150.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Check the answer key of your own paper and your own booklet series only.
  • Raise objections only within the window, which ends on 12 November 2026.
  • Give a specific justification and reference for every objection.
  • Check the fee shown on the portal before paying, and save the payment receipt and objection summary.
  • Use only the official UPESSC website. Do not enter login details on any other page.
  • Treat your probable score as an estimate until the final answer key and result are published.

How to Calculate Your Expected SBI PO Prelims Score

Expected Score = (Correct Answers x 1) - (Wrong Answers x 0.25)

UPSC subsequently published cut-off marks on 21 October 2026 and marks of recommended candidates on 30 October 2026.

Therefore, the answer keys issued on 4 November 2026 relate to an examination cycle for which the final recruitment result had already been declared.

  • Verify the question-paper series.
  • Compare answers using the question numbers printed in the PDF.
  • Check the maximum marks and dropped-question information.
  • Use the official examination rules when calculating scores.
  • Consult UPSC's already published results and marks for official performance information.

UPSC CMS 2026 Marking Scheme

UPSC accepts representations against the question paper and provisional answer keys only through its official online portal no email, post, or in-person submissions are entertained.

  2. Go to "Examinations" and select "Representations on Question Paper & Provisional Answer Keys."
  3. Choose the relevant question, paper, and reason for objection.
  4. Submit supporting justification where the portal allows it.
  5. Submit before the window closes  6:00 PM on the 7th day from the exam date. Nothing is entertained after this deadline.

  5. Accept the undertaking that the question paper is for personal use and self-analysis only.
  6. Your response sheet and the tentative answer key will appear on screen.
  7. Download the file and take a printout.

Things to Know About the Response Sheet

  • Question order may look different. The challenge module shows one fixed sequence of questions and options for all candidates of a shift, while the actual exam showed shuffled sequences.
  • Your answers are still accurate. The options you selected during the exam are shown correctly in the challenge module.
  • Personal use only. The saved question paper is meant for self-analysis, not for sharing.

How to Raise an Objection Against the SSC Selection Post Answer Key

If you believe an answer in the tentative key is wrong, you can challenge it online before 12 October 2026, 4:00 PM. Each challenged question costs ₹50.

  1. Log in to the SSC portal.
  2. Open the Challenge/Objection Management link for Phase-XIV/2026.
  3. Select the question or questions you want to challenge.
  4. Enter your suggested answer and upload supporting documents or a justification.
  5. Pay the ₹50 fee for each question challenged.
  6. Submit the objection before the deadline.

Rules to remember

  • Objections are accepted online only.
  • Objections received after 12 October 2026, 4:00 PM will not be entertained.
  • The final answer key is prepared after reviewing valid objections.
  • Candidates cannot challenge the final answer key.

How to Calculate Your Marks Using the Answer Key

Particulars Marks
Total questions 100
Total marks 200
Correct answer +2
Wrong answer −0.50
Unattempted 0

Formula: Total marks = (Correct answers × 2) − (Wrong answers × 0.50)

Example: A candidate attempts 85 questions, with 70 correct and 15 wrong. Marks = (70 × 2) − (15 × 0.50) = 140 − 7.5 = 132.5.

This is only an estimate. The answer key is tentative, and your score may change if SSC revises any answer after reviewing objections.

What Happens After the SSC Selection Post Answer Key?

  • The objection window closes on 12 October 2026, 4:00 PM.
  • SSC reviews the valid objections.
  • The final answer key is released.
  • The result and category-wise cut-off marks follow.
  • Shortlisted candidates are called for Document Verification.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 - Download Link, Scorecard, and Marking Scheme

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 on 17th June 2026, along with individual scorecards and response sheets for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26. Candidates who appeared in the Tier 2 exam, held on 18th and 19th January 2026, can now log in at ssc.gov.in using their Registration ID and password to download their final answer key, marks, and response sheet. The facility is available until 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM), after which the documents will no longer be accessible.

This release comes more than two months after SSC declared the Tier 2 final result on 8th April 2026, where 15,118 candidates were provisionally selected for various Group B and Group C posts. The final answer key now gives every candidate, selected or not, a way to verify exactly how their score was calculated.

Click Here: SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026: Key Highlights

The table below summarizes the most important details related to this release in one place for quick reference.

Particular Detail
Exam Name Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26 (Tier-II)
Exam Dates 18th and 19th January 2026
Conducting Body Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
Final Answer Key Release Date 17th June 2026
Also Released On Same Date Tier 2 Scorecards and Response Sheets
Login Requires Registration ID and Password
Last Date to Download 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM)

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

How to Download SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026?

Downloading the SSC GD provisional answer key is a straightforward process. Follow these step-by-step instructions to access both your response sheet and the shift-wise answer key from the SSC portal.

  1. Visit the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in
  2. On the homepage, click on the "Answer Key" tab under the Latest Updates or Candidate's Corner section.

  4. You will be redirected to the SSC candidate login portal.

  6. Your response sheet and the tentative answer key for your exam shift will appear on screen.
  7. Download both documents and save them as PDF files for future reference and score calculation.

SSC GD Response Sheet 2026 - What to Check

Along with the answer key, SSC has also uploaded the candidate response sheet, which contains all the answers marked by the candidate during the examination. SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 Marking Scheme - How to Calculate Your Score

Candidates can estimate their scores using the official marking scheme prescribed by SSC. For every correct answer, 2 marks are awarded. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 marks are deducted. Unattempted questions carry zero marks.

Response Type Marks
Correct Answer +2 Marks
Incorrect Answer -0.25 Marks
Unattempted Question 0 Marks

Score Calculation Formula:
Total Score = (No. of Correct Answers × 2) − (No. of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

Out of a total of 160 marks, candidates must score the following minimum marks to qualify in the Computer Based Test:

  • Unreserved (UR) / General: 30% = 48 marks
  • OBC / EWS: 25% = 40 marks
  • SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen: 20% = 32 marks

The objection window for the SSC GD Answer Key 2026 is open from 15th June 2026 (6:00 PM) to 20th June 2026 (6:00 PM). During this period, candidates who find any incorrect or disputed answer in the provisional key can formally challenge it by submitting valid supporting references and paying the prescribed fee.

How to Raise Objections Against SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026?

Follow these steps to challenge any answer in the provisional SSC GD 2026 answer key:

  1. Go to the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in
  2. Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
  3. Click on the "Challenge Answer Key" or "Raise Objections" option.
  4. Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
  5. Upload relevant supporting documents such as standard textbook references or authoritative sources to justify your objection.
  6. Pay the objection fee of ₹50 per question through the online payment gateway.
  7. Submit your challenge and download the acknowledgement receipt for your records.

SSC GD Constable Final Answer Key 2026 - What Happens Next?

After reviewing all the objections submitted by candidates, SSC release the SSC GD Final Answer Key 2026. It will contain revised answers if any changes are accepted by the Commission. The final answer key will then be used for preparing the SSC GD Result 2026. The final answer key cannot be challenged further and will be considered conclusive for result preparation. 

Candidates are advised to keep copies of both the provisional and final answer keys for future reference.

Role Snapshot

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

  • Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

  • Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

  • Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

  • Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

  • Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

  • Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

  • Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

  • Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

  • Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

  • Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

  • Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

  • Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

  • Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

  • Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

  • Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

  • Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

  • Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

  • Know Postgres and relational database practice.

  • Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

  • Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

  • Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

  • Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

  • Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

  • Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

Role overview

Role Snapshot

About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.
